title: A release's Play upload can be cancelled while it waits
what: The release's upload to Play and the store-listing run share one waiting line that keeps only one waiting run. If a listing or upload run is going and two more are started, the one that waited first is cancelled, which can be the release's own upload to the testing tracks.
expected: Every waiting Play run waits its turn; none is dropped.
how_often: rare: only when three Play runs overlap
fix_line: Retry a cancelled release upload, or give the release upload its own waiting line

title: The Razorpay check passes on main when its keys are gone
what: On a push to main the Razorpay test check runs with the stored test keys. If those keys are removed or empty, it prints SKIPPED and passes green, so a missing key looks like a working payment check.
expected: On main or a hand start, missing keys turn the check red; only a fork or pull request may skip.
who: the owner relying on the payment check
how_often: every push to main while the keys are missing
fix_line: Fail the check on main when the keys are missing

title: A change to the watch's release signing is not rehearsed before a release
what: The watch build check says it rehearses the release's signing with a throwaway key, but it only starts on a push when watch files change. A change to the shared signing script or the same-key check alone starts no rehearsal, so a mistake there is first seen when a release is tagged.
expected: A push that changes the release signing script or the same-key check starts the watch build check and its signing rehearsal.
how_often: every push that changes only the signing script or the same-key check
fix_line: Add the signing script and the same-key check to the watch build's push list

title: Old open shop orders drop off the gym's order list
what: The gym's order list only ever brings back the newest 300 orders, whatever their status. An order still waiting that is older than the newest 300 never reaches the desk, so it cannot be handed over or cancelled and its stock stays taken.
expected: Every open order (Ordered or Ready) is always on the list, however many orders are newer.
who: owners and front desk of busy shops
how_often: once a gym passes 300 orders with an old one still open
fix_line: Always return open orders, and cap only finished ones

title: Leaving the gym keeps the mobile number a member typed at check-in
what: When a member types a mobile number at check-in, it waits for the desk to confirm. If the member then leaves the gym in the app, the number is cleared from their app record but stays in the waiting request. The owner and front desk still see that request with the number, and approved or declined requests keep the number with no clean-up.
expected: Leaving the gym removes or blanks every mobile number the member gave, waiting requests included, as the delete-account page promises.
who: members who typed a number and then left
how_often: every time such a member leaves
fix_line: Clear the member's number requests when they leave

title: The admin app says support looks only when the owner lets them, but MettleUp can open the gym's records alone
what: The owner's 'MettleUp access' card and the Settings page say MettleUp support can look at the gym's records only when the owner lets them. MettleUp's own emergency door opens member names, mobiles, receipts and staff for up to an hour without asking the owner.
expected: The owner's words say plainly that MettleUp can also open access in an emergency, as the privacy page does, or the emergency door asks the owner.
how_often: every time an owner reads the card
fix_line: Add the emergency door to the owner's words on both screens

title: Wrong tries when changing a PIN lock it for only 15 minutes every time
what: Since the November security fix, wrong PINs on the sign-in page lock for longer each time in a day (15 minutes, then 1 hour). Wrong current PINs typed while changing the PIN in Settings still lock for a fixed 15 minutes and do not count toward the longer lock.
expected: Wrong current PINs in Settings count toward the same growing lock as the sign-in page.
how_often: every time someone guesses the current PIN while changing it
fix_line: Use the same growing lock when changing a PIN

title: A leaderboard update sent within 15 seconds of the last one is thrown away, even with new workouts
what: When a phone sends its day totals less than 15 seconds after its last send, with the name switch unchanged, the server answers OK and keeps nothing, even if a new workout was added. The design note says only a send that changes nothing should be ignored. The owner hiding a member also restarts the 15 seconds.
expected: A send with new numbers is always kept; only an identical send inside 15 seconds is skipped.
how_often: when two sends come close together, for example on opening the app right after a workout
fix_line: Skip only when the days sent are the same as the ones kept

title: A member's progress summary is stored again after they leave the gym
what: When a member leaves, their trainer summary is deleted at once. But the three ways the phone sends a summary never check whether the member has left, so the next send from an app that still has sharing on stores the summary again. Nobody at the gym can see it (the lists skip members who left), but it stays on the server until a trainer list is read 90 days later, against the privacy notice's promise that it is deleted on leaving. The gym mate sharing, by contrast, refuses a member who left.
expected: A send from a member who left is refused, and nothing is stored.
who: members who leave a gym with sharing still on
how_often: every time such an app sends after leaving
fix_line: Refuse the summary send for a member who has left, as the gym mate sharing does

title: In a paused gym a member cannot take back a request or clear an answer
what: While the gym is paused, the guard on the pause and renew requests also blocks deleting and updating them. Taking back a waiting request or marking an answer as seen then fails with an error, though the member side promises never to raise an error after the key check, and the other new tables allow deleting in a paused gym.
expected: Taking back a request and marking an answer as seen keep working in a paused gym; only new requests and decisions stop.
how_often: only while a gym is paused
fix_line: Let the pause guard allow deletes and the seen mark

title: The nightly backup can catch a payment without its receipt, though it says it never can
what: The nightly copy reads each table one after another inside a function marked as changing data. In the normal database mode such a function sees fresh data at every read, so a payment saved while the copy runs can be in one table of the copy and missing from the other. The file says every table is read at one moment.
expected: All tables in one copy are read at the same moment, so a restore never has a payment without its receipt.
how_often: rare: only when someone saves while the nightly copy runs
fix_line: Read all the tables in one read-only helper that sees a single moment, then write the audit line

title: What's new tells owners members get a pop-up when the gym sends a report they asked for, but the pop-up is for the gym asking
what: The admin app's What's new line says members get a notification when the gym sends the workout report they asked for. The server only makes a pop-up when the gym asks a member for their report; nothing pops up when a report is sent.
expected: The What's new line says members get a pop-up when the gym asks for their workout report.
fix_line: Change the What's new line to say the pop-up comes when the gym asks for the report

title: A real gym named "QA ..." is deleted overnight
what: The nightly clean-up of test gyms picks gyms only by name: any gym whose name starts with capital QA and a space, more than a day old, is deleted with all its members and money records. Nothing stops a real owner from naming a gym that way.
expected: Only gyms made by the phone tests are deleted, marked as test gyms when they are made; a real gym is never picked by its name.
how_often: rare: only a gym whose name starts with QA and a space
fix_line: Mark test gyms when they are made and delete only marked ones

title: AI credits can be given back for a task that worked
what: The give-back of AI credits accepts any spend from the last 10 minutes and marks the task failed; it never checks that the task really failed. An owner key calling it directly gets every task free.
expected: Credits come back only for a task that did not finish.
how_often: only when someone calls the server directly
fix_line: Refuse a give-back unless the task is still waiting or recorded as failed

title: The HQ Log records a feedback or lead change even when it was refused
what: When HQ saves a status on a feedback message or a lead, the Log line is written first. If the message or lead is gone, or the status is not one of the allowed ones, the change is refused but the Log still says it was made.
expected: The Log gets a line only when the change was really saved.
how_often: every refused feedback or lead save
fix_line: Write the Log line after the save, only when it changed a row

title: A lead sent from the member app shows an empty call link and no word where it came from
what: The member app's 'Tell my gym' sends a lead with only the gym's name and city, no mobile. The Leads page still draws the mobile as a call link (empty) and only names leads from a member's shared link, so HQ cannot tell who to call or why the number is missing.
expected: The card says the lead came from a member in the app, has no number, and how to reach the gym.
how_often: every lead sent from the member app's Tell my gym
fix_line: Label member-app leads and hide the call link when there is no number

title: Deleting a gym leaves the photos of its web page behind
what: When HQ deletes a whole gym, only the gym logo and the shop product photos are collected for removal. The photos the owner put on the gym web page stay in storage, and the success note still says the pictures were removed.
expected: Every file of the gym, its web page photos too, is removed, or the note lists what is left to remove by hand.
who: gyms that leave MettleUp after putting photos on their web page
how_often: every gym delete of a gym that had web page photos
fix_line: Also collect and remove the gym web page photos when a gym is deleted

title: MettleUp can open a gym's records without the gym saying yes, while the app promises it never does
what: HQ has an "Open in an emergency" button that opens read access to a gym's members, payments and staff without the gym asking. The gym owner's own screen and the pilot agreement say MettleUp support can look only when the gym lets them.
expected: Either the emergency opening is removed, or every promise says MettleUp may open it in an emergency and the owner is told with the reason.
how_often: every time HQ uses the emergency button
fix_line: Make the promise and the emergency button say the same thing

title: An empty daily limit box switches the gym's AI Assistant off
what: On a gym's HQ page, clearing "AI requests a day" or "Spoken minutes a day" and tapping "Save the limit" sends 0, which switches the AI Assistant off for that gym. The server would treat an empty box as the normal limit, but the page never sends it empty.
expected: An empty box keeps the normal limit, or the page asks for a number.
how_often: when HQ saves with a box left empty
fix_line: Send an empty box as empty, not as 0

title: A member checking their number in the app is told to go back to a "page" when the message has no code
what: When a member who started "Find my gym by my number" in the member app sends a WhatsApp message without the code, MettleUp replies "Go back to the MettleUp page, tap Open WhatsApp again". The member is in the app, not on a page. The success reply already says "app" for these members; the no-code reply does not.
expected: A member who started in the app is told to go back to the MettleUp app.
how_often: every time a member app check gets a message with no right code
fix_line: Give the no-code reply an app version, as the success reply has

title: Heart rate keeps the last number after the watch leaves the wrist
what: When the watch is taken off the wrist (or the sensor stops giving readings) with the screen on, the heart line keeps showing the last number, such as 132, as if it were live. The watch knows it is off the wrist but never shows it.
expected: The number goes to a dash, or a short word says the watch is off the wrist.
how_often: rarely: only with the watch off the wrist and the screen on mid-workout
fix_line: Clear the number when the watch says it is off the wrist or unavailable

title: A rest that ends seconds before a watch restart is left hanging
what: If a rest ends in the five seconds before the watch finishes restarting or the app finishes updating, the rest is neither set again nor cleared: no buzz, no card, and it stays saved as running until the app is opened or the phone sends something.
expected: A rest that ended moments ago either buzzes once (as a late phone message does) or is cleared.
how_often: rarely: a restart or update must end within seconds of a rest's end
fix_line: Treat a just-ended rest at start-up as over: buzz once or clear it

title: The check for full-size watch numbers cannot catch the bug it was written for
what: The automatic check that the watch countdown keeps its size at the largest text feeds the text size in the simple old way, so the newer Android scaling that made the numbers 23 % smaller is never tried. The old broken code would also pass it, so a return of the bug would not be noticed before release.
expected: The check runs with the real newer Android text scaling (or a watch on Wear OS 5), so the old shrinking code would fail it.
how_often: only if the size bug comes back
fix_line: Run the size check with the real Android text scaling instead of a simple multiplier

title: The invite page always says "You pay at the gym desk", even when the gym takes join payments online
what: The "Not a member yet?" card on a gym's invite link page always says the person pays at the gym desk. The link preview was changed to drop that sentence once online join payments are on, because the gym may then take the money online, but the card itself was not.
expected: The card says nothing about how to pay, or says the right way for this gym, like the link preview does.
who: people invited to a gym that takes online join payments
how_often: every visit once join payments are on
fix_line: Drop the pay sentence from the card, or fill it the same way as the preview

title: The daily limits on feedback, bring-a-friend and online join restart every morning at 05:30, not 24 hours later
what: The limit per internet address is meant to count the last 24 hours, but the coded address changes every day at 05:30 India time. Sends from before 05:30 are no longer seen, so one address can send up to twice the limit around that time.
expected: The limit counts every send from that address in the last 24 hours, or is stated as a per-day limit that resets at a fixed time.
who: everyone sending a form or feedback
fix_line: Count by the same day the coded address uses, or keep the coded address the same for 24 hours

title: The new owner sign-in code is tested only half way
what: The tests check the code needs the call tick and works for the owner. They never check that the picked owner of a two-owner gym gets the code, that the owner's old PIN stops working, that a used or older code is refused, or that the new code stays out of the HQ log.
expected: Tests cover the picked owner, the old PIN refused, a code working once, and the code missing from the log.
fix_line: Add the four missing checks to the HQ database test

title: Nothing checks that staff names leave the sign-in history when support access ends
what: The test opens support access and sees names and devices in the sign-in history. It never closes the window and looks again, so names staying on after the window ends would pass.
expected: A test closes the window and checks the history is back to times only.
fix_line: Close the window in the test and check the history again

title: The support view test never checks what a member record shows
what: The test of the read-only support view checks payment and staff records only. The member record, the one that could show Aadhaar or PAN, has no check, so adding such a field would pass unnoticed.
expected: A test checks a member record shows only name, mobile and id.
fix_line: Add a member record to the support view test

title: The web page switch test always says yes and never checks that switching on asks nothing
what: The browser test answers every question with yes, so Cancel is never tried. Its comment says switching on asks no question, but it never checks that no question came.
expected: The test taps Cancel once and checks nothing changed, and checks no question appears when switching on.
fix_line: Add a Cancel step and a no-question check

title: The HQ journey for 3 branches gives the wrong Starter price
what: The journey says 3 branches cost Starter ₹2,497 a month. By the half-price rule it is ₹1,997, which is what HQ shows and what the test checks. Someone testing by the journey would report a fault that is not there.
expected: The journey says Starter ₹1,997 or Pro ₹2,997 for 3 branches.
fix_line: Correct the price in the journey

title: Nothing checks that HQ's private note on a message stays private
what: HQ can write a note on each feedback message that only HQ should see. The feedback tests check the phone address never reaches the page, but no test checks the note stays out of the member and admin apps or survives a status change.
expected: A test checks the note never goes to the apps and is kept when the status changes.
fix_line: Add a note to the feedback test and check both apps' answers

title: Most HQ screens are never opened by an automated test
what: Only the payments list and the web page switch are driven in a browser. Leads, Delete requests, Log, the menu, the Needs you words, alerts and the install button are checked only through helpers or the server, or not at all. 13 of 43 journeys have no test.
expected: Each HQ screen people use has a browser test that checks its words and its refusals.
fix_line: Add one browser test per HQ screen with a fake server, like the payments one

title: The gym delete test never tries pictures that cannot be removed
what: The only test of picture removal has every picture removed. The case where some stay, with its message and its log line, is never run.
expected: A test where storage refuses a picture checks the "pictures are left" words and the log line.
fix_line: Add a test where storage refuses one picture

title: The "nothing left" check after a gym delete looks at only two tables
what: HQ tells the admin it checked every table and nothing is left. The database test only counts the gym row and the main records table; the server test feeds in a made-up table count.
expected: The test checks every table with a gym column is empty for the deleted gym.
fix_line: Loop over every table with a gym column in the database test

title: No test opens the AI Assistant at the daily question limit
what: The words for the daily free questions are checked, and the server refuses after the limit, but no test opens the assistant with questions running out. Nothing checks that the line shows above the box, that the box greys out, that the microphone and send buttons turn off, or that a message card at the limit keeps its words.
expected: A screen test that uses up the day's questions and checks the line, the locked box, the off buttons and a card at the limit.
fix_line: Add one screen test that reaches the daily limit and checks the locked box

title: The History tab is only checked for one done task
what: The only check of History is that a done task shows its credit. Its loading line, the empty words, the no-internet words, the 'Not sent', 'Cancelled' and 'Did not work' marks, the 30-row cap and tapping a task to ask again are never tested.
expected: Tests for each History state and status mark, and for tapping a task back into the box without doing it again.
fix_line: Add History tests for empty, offline and each task status

title: Cancel, done-already and credit-given-back words on a card are never tested
what: Tests check that a failed save asks for the credit back and that a double tap saves once, but nothing checks what the owner reads: 'Cancelled. Nothing was sent or saved...', 'This was done already.', 'Your credit was given back.', or that the card opens again for a real second try.
expected: A test per card ending (cancel, failure with credit back, retry, done already) that checks the words and the card state.
fix_line: Test the card's words after cancel, failure and a repeat tap

title: A test locks in that an archived member is never found, so the assistant offers to add him again
what: The name-matching test requires an archived member to come back as nobody found. Asking about him then only offers 'Add him as a new member', which makes a second record for the same person, and gives no word that he is archived.
expected: An archived member is found and the card says he is archived or offers to bring him back; the test checks that.
how_often: when an archived member is named
fix_line: Match archived members separately and say so on the card

title: The 'Which one?' and 'No member found' cards are never checked on screen
what: Tests check the name matcher picks one member, a choice, or nobody, but no test shows the 'Which one?' card with its buttons, the 'No member found' card, or that 'Add Zoya as a new member' opens an unsaved add card.
expected: A screen test for two members of one name and for a name not on the list.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the member choice and not-found cards

title: The plan writer's waiting, reopening and rewriting are never tested
what: Writing and saving one plan is tested end to end. The 'Writing…' wait words, a second tap while writing, closing the plan and opening it again with the changes, 'Write it again', the done card's 'Open Workout plans' and the 'could not be used' line are not.
expected: Screen tests for each of those plan writer states.
fix_line: Add plan writer screen tests for wait, reopen and rewrite

title: How the floating AI button moves and hides is never tested
what: Tests check where the button sits and that the side panel is 420 wide. Nothing checks that the button shrinks while scrolling and comes back, hides while typing or with a sheet open, never covers the bottom bar or the keyboard, that the page moves over for the panel, or that the chat survives closing and opening.
expected: Phone and computer screen tests for each of those button and panel behaviours.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the button while scrolling, typing and with the panel

title: Most 'Today for you' rows are checked only as data
what: The idea list is checked as data. On screen only the birthday, festival and not-seen rows are tested. The 'Plans ending this week' row and its buttons, the week summary on Monday, tapping an idea from Today into the assistant, greyed rows while busy and the empty gym with no heading are never checked on screen.
expected: Screen tests for the ending row, the Monday row, the empty gym and a tap from Today.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the remaining idea rows and the empty gym

title: The money and dues answer cards are checked only as data
what: Tests check the figures the answers work out, but no test shows the 'Fees due' card with its rows, the 'Open Dues' link, the 'Send them a fee reminder' button, or compares its total with the Dues page. The money, attendance and week cards are never seen on screen either.
expected: A screen test that asks who owes and checks the card against the Dues page, then sends the fee reminder.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the fees due answer and its reminder

title: The ask box and message card error lines are never seen in a test
what: The server refuses empty and over-long requests, but no test checks the send button is off for an empty box, the box stops at 600 letters, 'The AI Assistant did not understand. Say it another way.', the no-internet line, or the message card lines 'This group could not be found.', 'Write the message.' and 'The app list could not load.'.
expected: Tests that show each of these lines on the screen.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the box limits and each card error line

title: A test requires a birthday group message to reach the member who already gets the automatic wish
what: With the automatic birthday wish on, a test requires that a message the AI drafts for 'birthday today' still goes to every birthday member, including the one the automatic wish already reaches. That member gets two wishes.
expected: A group birthday message leaves out members the automatic wish reaches, or the card warns before sending.
how_often: each birthday with the automatic wish on
fix_line: Leave auto-wished members out of a birthday group message

title: Tapping the birthday idea sends members' full names to the AI though the owner never typed them
what: With the automatic birthday wish on, the birthday idea puts 'Send birthday wishes to' plus the members' full names in the request, and a test requires that. Tapping the idea sends that sentence to the AI, so member names leave the gym although the owner did not say them, against what the assistant promises.
expected: An idea sends a fixed sentence with no member names, and the names are filled in on the device; a test checks no name goes out.
how_often: each tap on a birthday idea
fix_line: Send a group sentence to the AI and add the names on the device

title: No test opens the History tab's loading, failed, empty or not-sent states
what: The only History check is one line on a computer that a done task says 'Done · 1 credit'. Nothing checks the 'could not load' line, the 'Nothing yet' line, rows that say Not sent, Cancelled or Did not work with no credits, or that tapping a row puts the words back in the box without asking.
expected: A test drives History offline, empty, and with each kind of task, and taps a row.
fix_line: Add one screen test for the History tab covering failed, empty, each status and a row tap.

title: The voice sheet's problem lines and Cancel are never seen by a test
what: Tests only check that a browser error is turned into a short code. No test shows the blocked, no-microphone, too-short or nothing-heard sentences, the Close button, Cancel stopping the microphone, the 30 second stop, or that the owner can fix the words before sending.
expected: A screen test fakes each microphone problem and Cancel, and edits the heard words before sending.
fix_line: Add a voice screen test for each problem line, Cancel, the time limit and editing the words.

title: No test taps an idea's action button or the credits pill on Today
what: Tests check the ideas fit the phone and that See who lists the right members, but none taps the action button that should open the assistant with the idea asked once and a draft to check, and none taps the credits pill. The known bug where an idea is dropped when questions are used up has no test either.
expected: A test taps an idea's button (normal and with today's questions used up) and the pill, and checks what opens.
fix_line: Add a Today test that taps an idea's button and the pill and checks the assistant opens with one ask.

title: The examples sheet and the Try saying sentences are opened but never used in a test
what: The test opens 'What the AI Assistant can do' and closes it. Nothing checks its groups, that the number in the link equals the sentences, or that tapping a sentence closes the sheet and puts it in the box without asking.
expected: A test taps an example, checks it lands in the box unsent, and counts the sheet's sentences against the link.
fix_line: Extend the assistant screen test to tap an example and count the sheet.

title: No test shows the ask box locked when today's free questions are used up
what: Tests only check that the locked words have a Hindi version and that the limit code counts as locked. Nothing checks on screen that the box is greyed out, send stays off, and a tapped example does not get asked.
expected: A screen test with the day limit reached checks the locked box, the off send button and that nothing is asked.
how_often: once a day for busy gyms
fix_line: Add a screen test with the day limit reached.

title: A question-back card's choices and typed answer are never tested
what: The test only reads the question text. Nothing checks the choice buttons, at most six of them, that tapping one asks it once, the 'Type your answer in the box below.' line when there are no choices, or that the answer keeps the question in mind.
expected: A test taps a choice and answers a no-choice question, checking one new bubble and the next card.
fix_line: Add choice-tap and typed-answer steps to the assistant screen test.

title: No assistant test taps twice or clears the chat
what: No test double-taps send, a choice, Send to AI Assistant or Save changes to prove one tap makes one request or one save, and no test clears the chat to check the examples come back and saved tasks stay.
expected: Tests double-tap each sending button and clear the chat once.
fix_line: Add double-tap and clear-chat steps to the assistant tests.

title: No test checks that a sign-in code works only once and dies after 30 minutes
what: The screens say a code from the owner works once, for 30 minutes. The server tests check wrong tries and that a new code works, but none uses the same code twice or waits past 30 minutes. The browser tests use a pretend server, so they cannot prove it either.
expected: A server test signs in with a code, then tries the same code again and a code older than 30 minutes; both are refused.
fix_line: Add two checks to the sign-in server test: same code twice, and a 31-minute-old code

title: The code sheet the owner hands to staff is barely tested
what: Tests only check that the code sheet opens with a code. Nothing checks "Making…" and the other buttons greyed, "Works once, till …", the WhatsApp button and its message on screen, "Code copied", the row line "Code works till …", or the refusals (already removed, too many tries, no internet).
expected: A browser test makes a code and checks each of those words and the refusals.
fix_line: Add one browser test for the code sheet, its buttons, its row line and its refusals

title: Add a person: most refusals are never tested
what: Only the missing job is tested. No test types no name, a bad number, a number already on the list, or a number on another branch’s staff. No test removes a person and adds them again, or checks the half-added trainer message.
expected: Each refusal shows its words and adds nothing; a removed person can be added again with no old PIN.
fix_line: Add the four refusals and the add-again case to the jobs browser test

title: A locked PIN is never shown on screen in any test
what: Tests lock a PIN with wrong tries, but never open Staff & sign-in to check the row line "PIN locked till …" or the You card words about the lock, nor that the lock words go after a WhatsApp check or a code.
expected: After five wrong tries the owner sees the lock time on the row and the person sees it on their own card; after a proven number both go.
fix_line: After the lock in the PIN browser test, open Staff & sign-in and check the lock words, then clear it

title: The Trainer tick on a person’s row is never tapped in a test
what: The tick is only tested when a person is added as Trainer. No test ticks or unticks an existing row, checks the tick’s words, the pill change, or the error and unchanged tick when the save fails.
expected: A browser test ticks and unticks a desk person, sees the pill change, and sees an error with the tick unchanged when the server refuses.
fix_line: Add tick, untick and a refused save to the jobs browser test

title: Signing out with a payment the server refused is never tested
what: The only sign-out test with saved items has one waiting check-in. No test signs out while a payment the server refused is kept, signs back in and checks it is still there. No test signs out of a gym with branches, or checks the many-items words.
expected: A test keeps a refused payment, signs out, signs in again with a PIN, and sees the payment still named at the top.
how_often: every sign out with an unsent item
fix_line: Add a sign-out test with a refused payment and a branch gym

title: Staff & sign-in error states are never tested
what: No test opens Staff & sign-in for a gym not online yet ("Put your gym online first"), with the internet failing while online, or has Sign out everywhere fail or hit a person already removed.
expected: Each case shows its words, keeps the buttons usable, and never shows an empty list as if nobody could sign in.
fix_line: Add the not-online, no-internet and already-removed cases to the people browser test

title: Forgot PIN is tested only for the owner
what: Every Forgot PIN test uses the owner. No test runs it for a front desk person (front desk rights after, no money totals) or for a removed person (refused). The steps after the number is checked (run out, internet drop) are also never tested; the wrong words there are already listed.
expected: Forgot PIN tests for a desk person, a removed person, and a check that runs out after the number is checked.
fix_line: Run the Forgot PIN browser test also as a desk person and as a removed person

title: Put your gym online: its refusals and last card are never tested
what: No test leaves the name empty ("Type your name.") or types a bad number on this card, checks "Putting your gym online…" with the button greyed, or reads the card "Signed in as … Your gym is online…" after.
expected: A test checks both refusals send nothing, the busy button, and the final card words.
fix_line: Add the empty name, bad number and final card checks to the go-online browser test

title: No test proves sign-out is held while saved items still wait to send
what: Staff and sign-in turns the sign-out button off while things saved on this device have not reached the server, so a payment is not lost. No automated test saves something offline and then tries to sign out.
expected: A test saves a payment with no internet, opens Staff and sign-in, and checks sign-out is off with the wait-for-All-sent words, then on once sent.
how_often: every sign-out with a weak connection
fix_line: Add one end-to-end test for sign-out with items waiting

title: Removing a person is tested only on the happy path
what: The only test removes one desk person once. Nothing checks the person already removed from another device, a double tap, Cancel leaving the person in place, the owner row having no Remove button, or adding a removed person back with a fresh code.
expected: Tests cover the already-removed words, one call per tap, Cancel changing nothing, no Remove on the own row, and re-adding a removed person.
fix_line: Add the five missing cases to the people test

title: No test proves the gym records leave the device after sign-out or removal
what: Tests check the welcome page and its words after a sign-out or a removal, but none checks that members, payments and the gym name are no longer kept on the device, nor what happens to items still waiting to send.
expected: A test signs out (and one removes the person) and checks the device copy of the gym is gone, and unsent items are not dropped without a word.
who: owners, front desk and members whose details sit on a shared computer
how_often: every sign-out on a shared device
fix_line: Add a check of the device copy after sign-out and after removal

title: The signed-out notice is never tested with no internet, a second tab, or a later sign-in
what: Tests show the signed-out and removed words once on one tab. None checks the words when the reason cannot be asked offline, a second tab following the sign-out, the notice going away after signing in again, or showing once only.
expected: Tests cover the offline reason, a second tab, the notice cleared after sign-in, and one notice per sign-out.
how_often: each time someone is signed out
fix_line: Add tests for the offline, two-tab and after-sign-in cases

title: No test signs in as a trainer
what: Every sign-in, PIN and sign-out test uses the owner or a plain front desk person. A trainer (a desk person with the Trainer tick) never signs in, sets a PIN or signs out in any test, so a change that treats trainers differently would not be caught.
expected: At least one test signs a trainer in with a code, sets a PIN, checks the pages they see, and signs out.
fix_line: Add one trainer sign-in journey to the end-to-end tests

title: The Change my PIN sheet is tested only for the owner, and the locked words never
what: Only the owner opens Change my PIN in a test. The staff version, with its own "ask your gym owner" forgot words, is never opened, and the "Your PIN is locked till" card line is never shown in any test.
expected: Tests open Change my PIN as a desk person and check its words, and show the locked line after five wrong tries.
how_often: when a PIN is changed or locked
fix_line: Add a desk Change my PIN test and a locked-card check

title: The Create my gym no-answer path is tested only as words
what: When Create my gym gets no answer, the form offers Sign in instead with the number filled. Only the words are unit tested. No test drives the button, checks the number carries over, or that trying again does not make a second gym.
expected: An end-to-end test drops the answer, taps Sign in instead, checks the number, signs in to the gym that was made, and checks one gym only.
how_often: on a slow connection at sign-up
fix_line: Add one end-to-end test for the no-answer path

title: No test changes the number after it was checked, or uses a run-out check on Create my gym
what: Tests check a used proof is refused by the server. No screen test changes the mobile after "Number checked", or shows "This check has run out" with a button to check again.
expected: Tests change the number after the check and see the check go, and see the run-out words with the button to check again.
how_often: when a sign-up is slow or the number is retyped
fix_line: Add the two cases to the WhatsApp sign-up test

title: No test proves the PIN, code or mobile stay out of the address bar and browser storage
what: Server tests prove the PIN is never sent back. No panel test looks at the address bar, local storage or the device copy after typing a PIN, a code or a mobile at sign-in, sign-up or Forgot your PIN.
expected: A test signs in, signs up and resets a PIN, then checks the address and browser storage hold no PIN, code or typed mobile.
fix_line: Add a storage and address check to the sign-in tests

title: The support window is never shown on screen after its hour ends
what: The server test proves reads stop after an hour. The screen test closes the window early only. No test lets the hour pass and checks the card stops offering Close it now, or checks a double tap opens one window.
expected: A test opens a window, moves the clock past the hour, and checks the card shows the past window and the open button again; and one window per double tap.
fix_line: Add a clock-past-the-hour step to the access test

title: Saving a PIN from the one-time 'Set your own PIN' sheet is never tested
what: The only screen test of the sheet taps 'Not now' and sets the PIN later in Settings. No test saves from the sheet itself, sees 'Saving...' or the 3-second 'PIN saved' note, taps twice, or reloads before answering. No test signs a trainer in with a code at all, and no owner without a PIN is tested on screen.
expected: A screen test that saves a PIN from the sheet (once, with the note that goes away), and one that reloads before answering and still sees the sheet.
fix_line: Add a screen test that saves from the sheet and one that reloads before answering

title: The owner-only card's 'Back to Today' button and its reload are never tested
what: Tests check that Staff see 'Only an owner can see this' on owner pages, but none checks the 'Ask your gym owner' line, taps 'Back to Today', goes back, or reloads on the card.
expected: A test that taps 'Back to Today' and lands on Today, and that a reload or Back keeps the card without showing the owner page.
how_often: whenever staff open an old owner link
fix_line: Extend the front-desk test to tap Back to Today and reload on the card

title: Two desk safety messages are never tested: device out of space, and repeated save clashes
what: The message 'Nothing was saved: this device is out of space...' and 'Someone else is saving at the same time. Please try again.' are each written once in the code, and no test makes them appear or checks that nothing shows as saved.
expected: A test per case: a full device refuses the save with that message and shows nothing as saved; repeated clashes end with the clash message and no success note.
who: owners and staff at the desk
how_often: rare, on a full device or a busy desk
fix_line: Add two data tests that trigger the full device and the repeated clash

expected: A browser test signed in as the desk in a gym with two branches opens Add member and Edit member and checks the every-branch box is absent, then adds a member from an enquiry.
fix_line: Add a desk-login browser test of Add and Edit member in a two-branch gym

title: Tests require another branch to find a member who is not allowed there
what: The journey says a member without the every-branch tick must not be findable by mobile at another branch's desk. The tests require the opposite: the other branch finds him, sees his first name and home branch, and is told his plan is for that branch only.
expected: Decide which is right. If the desk should be told, fix the journey; if not, the lookup should answer nobody for an unticked member and the tests should say so.
how_often: every look-up of a one-branch member at another branch
fix_line: Pick one rule for unticked members at other branches and make the journey and tests agree

title: Turning off 'train at every branch', and ticking it on Add member, are never tested
what: The only test ticks the box on Edit member. Nothing ticks it on Add member, reopens a member to see it still ticked, unticks it, or checks the member is then refused at the other branch.
expected: A browser test ticks on Add member, reopens and sees the tick, unticks, and checks the other branch can no longer check the member in.
how_often: whenever a member's branch access is taken away
fix_line: Extend the branch check-in test to untick the box and retry the check-in

title: The batch chips on the member form are never seen by a test
what: Only the batch rules are tested (spelling, counting, 40-letter limit). No test shows the chip row, picks a chip, uses '+ New batch', reads the 40-letter words, or sees the batch under the member's name.
expected: A browser test adds two members to a batch, checks the chip with its count, the new-batch box and its words, and that removing the last member's batch removes the chip.
how_often: every member added to a batch
fix_line: Add a browser test of the batch chips on Add and Edit member

title: Making an enquiry a member is untested when the number is taken or the form is cancelled
what: No test opens Add as member on an enquiry whose number belongs to a member who is not archived (the 'is already a member' sheet with 'Mark joined and open'), or cancels the prefilled form and checks the enquiry is still open. The app-members tab test checks only that the form opens, not what it is filled with.
expected: Browser tests for the taken-number sheet and its Cancel, a cancelled enquiry form, and the app-member prefill with +91.
how_often: whenever a known person enquires again
fix_line: Add browser tests for the taken-number sheet and a cancelled enquiry form

title: A pass member's break and restart, and '+ Other company', are never tested on screen
what: The rules keep the first pass day and clear it on untick, but no browser test reopens a pass member to see the tick and company, unticks and re-ticks, types a company through '+ Other company', or checks past pass visits stay counted.
expected: A browser test edits a FITPASS member: sees the tick, unticks, re-ticks, and checks the start day and past visits; another types 'fit pass' under Other company and finds one FITPASS chip.
how_often: whenever a pass member stops or restarts
fix_line: Extend the pass browser test with untick, re-tick and Other company

title: The sell sheet with no plans on sale is never opened in a test
what: No test opens Sell membership in a gym with no plans, or with every plan switched off. The owner and desk banners, the missing form and Confirm, and the sheet after a plan is added are never seen. One unit test only checks that the desk words are written in the source file.
expected: A test opens the sheet with no plans as owner and desk, checks each banner and that nothing can be saved, then adds a plan and sells it.
who: owners and front desk of a new gym
how_often: every new gym, before the first plan
fix_line: Add one screen test for the empty sell sheet, owner and desk, then after a plan is added

title: Selling or renewing a PT pack is never done on screen in a test
what: No screen test sells a PT pack. The PT line and its one-session wording, the start jumping to today, the emptied boxes, Renew PT on the PT card, Renew PT hidden for a plan off sale, and a second pack beside the first are checked only as data or not at all.
expected: A screen test sells and renews a PT pack beside a running gym plan, as owner and desk, and checks the words, the dates and the saved pack.
who: owners and front desk selling personal training
fix_line: Add a screen test that sells and renews a PT pack beside a gym plan

title: The UPI QR on the sell sheet is never tested
what: No test shows the UPI QR while selling a plan. Paid by changing to UPI, Received now filling with the total, the QR amount following a typed part amount, and no receipt being made just because the QR is shown are not checked. Only the QR picture builder is tested on its own.
expected: A screen test shows the QR on the sell sheet, checks the method, the amount and the due line, and that no receipt is made until Confirm.
who: owners and front desk taking UPI at the sale
fix_line: Add a screen test for the UPI QR on the sell sheet

title: Many sell sheet hints and error words are never checked
what: No test checks "Charged once, on joining.", the "Last day they can train" line, the hint naming the day the current plan ends, "Leave blank if they will pay later", "Saving…", or the error words for a wrong price, a wrong received amount and a wrong start day. The Sell button inside "No memberships yet" is never tapped. The rules behind the errors are checked only as data.
expected: Screen tests check each hint and each error sentence on the sell sheet, and that the section button opens the same sheet.
fix_line: Add the missing hint and error sentences to the sell sheet screen tests

title: The desk selling with part or no payment, or an old payment date, is never tested
what: Signed in as the desk, no test sells with part of the money, with nothing received, or with a payment date more than 31 days back on the sell sheet. The desk never sees the high-price question in a test. These are checked only as the owner or as data.
expected: A desk screen test sells with part and no payment, checks the due line and Dues, the old payment date refusal on the sell sheet, and the high-price question.
how_often: every desk sale that is not paid in full
fix_line: Extend the desk sell test with part, nothing and old-date payments and the high-price question

title: Cancelling a receipt offline, on failure, or for a non-membership receipt is never tested
what: No test cancels a receipt that is not for a membership, tries to cancel while offline, sees the server refuse a cancel, or checks that a double cancel adds the money to dues only once.
expected: Tests cover the non-membership words, the offline block, the failure banner with the reason still typed, and a double cancel leaving one due change.
how_often: when a receipt is cancelled on bad internet or for a shop or other fee
fix_line: Add tests for the offline, failure and non-membership cancel paths

title: Nothing checks what a member sees of the sale note, dues and cancel reason
what: No test opens the member app after a sale with a note, a part payment or a cancelled receipt, to check that the gym note, the cancel reason, the taker phone number and other members dues stay hidden, and that the due shows in the app own words.
expected: A test reads the member app after these sales and checks what is shown and what stays hidden.
how_often: every sale with a note or a part payment
fix_line: Add a member app check after a sale with a note, a part payment and a cancel

title: No test proves dues of a cancelled plan stop being chased
what: No test cancels a plan that still has money due, or a receipt whose plan is cancelled, and then checks that the member leaves Dues and gets no fee reminder.
expected: A test cancels a part-paid plan and checks Dues and the reminder list leave the member out.
fix_line: Add a test that a cancelled plan drops out of Dues and reminders

title: The Attendance page is never opened by a test
what: No browser test opens Attendance. Checking a member in, removing a check-in, the day picker refusing a future day, the "Nobody matches that" and "Start checking members in" words, the tiles and the losing-the-habit cards are only checked as data, never on the screen the desk uses every morning.
expected: At least one browser test checks a member in and out, picks a future day and an empty register, and reads the tiles and a losing-the-habit card.
fix_line: Add one browser test that drives the Attendance page through check-in, undo, a future day and the empty states

title: The losing-the-habit file download has no test at all
what: No test makes the file of members who are losing the habit. Nothing checks its columns, that it holds exactly the rows on screen, that archived and filtered-out members stay out, that no money column is added, or that mobile numbers keep their digits in a spreadsheet.
expected: A test makes the file from a filtered list and checks the columns, the rows, the mobile numbers and the "Exported N members." message.
fix_line: Add a test for the file: columns, rows equal to the screen, phone digits kept

title: Batches are never seen on screen in any test
what: The batch box, its chips, the "All batches (N)" filter with counts, the "Searching only <batch>" hint on Attendance and "Nobody in this batch" are never opened by a test. Only the batch rules are checked as data.
expected: A browser test adds two members to a batch, picks it in the Members filter and on Attendance, and reads the counts and hints.
fix_line: Add one browser test for the batch chips, the filter and the Attendance hint

title: Bold urgent lines, the Payment label and tapping a browser notice are never checked
what: On Today and in the bell, no test checks that an urgent line still waiting is bold, that a payment line has its own colour and a "Payment" label (so colour is not the only sign), or what opens when a browser notice is tapped. The payment colour is checked only as data.
expected: A test reads the bold and the Payment label on screen and taps a notice to see Today or the alert page open.
fix_line: Add checks for bold, the Payment label and a notice tap to the alerts browser test

title: Sending a message to just one group in the app is never seen on screen
what: The only browser test of Messages uses a server where an app message goes to every member. With a server that sends to a group, the "In the app / Not in the app" line, the "Not in the app" and "Whole group" choices, the empty-group words and the send reaching only that group are checked only as data, so a wrong count or a message to the whole gym would not be caught.
expected: A browser test with group sending on picks a small group, reads the two counts and sends, then checks only that group's app members were in the send.
fix_line: Add a browser test of a group send with a group-capable pretend server

title: Automatic reminders: the offline card and refused saves are never seen on screen
what: No test shows "Automatic reminders need your gym online", a save the server refuses, the "One of the numbers is not allowed" words, the "Days without a check-in" error, "Saving…", or a saved row where only one reminder is damaged.
expected: The reminders browser test also covers an offline gym, a refused save and a damaged saved row.
fix_line: Add the offline, refused and damaged-row cases to the reminders browser test

title: Changing the birthday switch while Today is open is never tested
what: The birthday tests set the switch before the page opens. Nothing checks that Today follows a switch changed on the same visit, that an old answer cannot win over a new save, or that a member whose app number stops matching is suggested again within about 5 minutes. No test does this as front desk.
expected: A test changes the switch and the app list while Today is open and sees the count follow, as owner and as desk.
fix_line: Add a live switch change and a 5-minute recheck to the birthday browser test

title: Two measurement messages are never tested
what: Nothing checks "That entry was deleted on another device. Close this and look again." (the panel could show a raw code instead) or "Note: up to 200 letters." The deleting state is not checked either.
expected: The measurement words test covers the deleted-elsewhere answer and the note limit.
fix_line: Add the not-found and note-limit words to the measurement tests

title: No test checks that a trainer never gets a feedback line
what: The server alert test looks only at questions and complaints for the trainer, and the browser bell test has no feedback line. Nothing would catch a trainer seeing, or being rung for, a member's feedback.
expected: A test gives the gym a feedback alert and checks the trainer's list, bell and notice leave it out.
fix_line: Add a feedback alert to the trainer checks in the server and bell tests

title: The 'came in today with fees due' card is tested only once, as the owner, on the plan-ended message
what: One owner test shows the card with two members and opens the message for the member whose plan ended. No test opens it for a member who owes money, so nobody checks the fees message is the one chosen. No test taps a name, shows more than 5 people with the link to the register, pays from the card and sees the member leave, or opens Today on a front-desk login.
expected: Tests that check the fees message for a member who owes, the 5-row limit and register link, the card emptying after payment, and the same card on a front-desk login.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the fees message, the more-than-5 list, paying from the card and the desk login

title: Your growth for a young gym and its first-and-latest comparison are checked only as data
what: The page test opens Your growth from Today and More and checks a brand-new gym's lead words. The first-months against latest-months page, the switch after old records are imported, the chart words for a new gym, the What is new way in, and whether the printed report is cut off or prints menus are never seen in a test.
expected: A screen test for a gym with a few months and no old records, one after an import, and a print check of the report.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the first-and-latest months page, an import changing it, and the printed page

title: The 'needs your gym online' cards on Challenges and Diet plans are never tested
what: A gym that is not online should see a card saying Challenges or Diet plans need the gym online, and no button that saves nowhere. No test opens either page on a gym that is only in the browser.
expected: A test that opens both pages on a browser-only gym and checks the card words and that no new button is offered.
fix_line: Add a test opening Challenges and Diet plans on a gym that is not online

title: Checking a workout code is tested only as the owner, and most of its messages only as data
what: The one screen test checks a code as the owner and gives the days. No test checks a code on a front-desk login, where the desk must see that the owner gives the days and no give button. The never-used-letter message, the old-code words, the old result clearing when a new code is typed, and the empty box after closing are never seen on screen.
expected: A desk-login test of the code check without the give button, and screen checks of the old-code, wrong-letter and cleared-result cases.
fix_line: Add a desk-login code check and screen checks of the old, wrong-letter and changed-code cases

title: Money's empty pages, the Dues link and the dues file are never tested
what: No test opens Money on a gym with nothing collected or nobody owing, so the empty words, the greyed download and 'No dues' are never seen. No test opens the Dues link straight, downloads the dues file, opens an empty age group, or shows the desk a part-paid member staying in the list.
expected: Tests for the empty Money and Dues pages, the Dues link, the dues file matching the filtered list, and a part payment on the desk login.
fix_line: Add tests for empty Money and Dues, the Dues link, the dues file and a desk part payment

title: No test saves a report file as the front desk, after a filter change, or with Hindi names
what: Files are downloaded in tests only as the owner, for collections, growth, renewals and pass visits. No test downloads a file on a desk login, checks that the desk has no dues download, downloads twice after changing a filter, checks the greyed button on an empty list, or opens a file with Hindi names or long mobile numbers.
expected: Tests for a desk-login file with no money in it, two downloads around a filter change, the greyed button on an empty list, and a file with Hindi names and mobiles read back.
fix_line: Add download tests on a desk login, after a filter change, on an empty list and with Hindi names

title: Editing a diet plan and copying a withdrawn one are never tested on screen
what: The screen test makes, sends and withdraws a diet plan. It never edits a plan and checks the updated toast and that members keep it, never taps the copy button on a withdrawn plan, and never taps save twice or sees a failed save.
expected: A screen test that edits a sent plan, copies a withdrawn one and checks nobody is ticked, and taps save twice.
fix_line: Add a screen test for editing a plan, copying a withdrawn one and a double tap on save

title: The add-enquiry link, the call-again date sheet and the 90-day chat line are never tested
what: No test opens the add-enquiry address straight, opens the 'Call <name> again' sheet and moves the date, or shows the line that a web page chat was deleted after 90 days. Another gym's enquiries are never checked to stay out.
expected: Tests for the add-enquiry address, moving a follow-up date with the sheet, and the chat deletion line.
fix_line: Add tests for the add-enquiry address, the call-again sheet and the deleted-chat line

title: The only screen test of Help and feedback runs in the demo gym, where that page is replaced
what: The one browser test that types and sends a message in Help and feedback starts the demo gym first. In the demo the app swaps that page for a 'needs a real gym' note with no message box, so the test cannot reach the box it fills: it either fails every run or is not really run. The demo's More list also still shows the Help and feedback row, though the journey says the demo must not offer it. The AI answer box, 'Did this solve it?' and 'Your questions' are never seen on a screen.
expected: The test signs in to an online gym (owner and staff), sends a question, sees the AI answer with its label and Yes/No, and checks 'Your questions'. A second check that the demo gym does not offer the page.
fix_line: Move the help test to an online gym and add the answer, rating and history checks

title: The GST journey and the GST tests disagree on what old receipts show
what: The journey says that once a gym adds its GSTIN an old receipt shows a tax split, and that removing the GSTIN takes the tax lines off. The tests lock the opposite: a receipt keeps the GST state of the day it was taken, so an old receipt stays plain and a registered one keeps its tax. The tests look right for tax law; the journey lines are wrong, so anyone working from the journey would change the wrong thing.
expected: One rule, the same in the journey and the tests: a receipt shows tax only if the gym was registered on the day of the sale.
fix_line: Correct the old-receipt lines in the GST journey

title: The workout report card on a member's page is never opened in a screen test
what: The server rules and the words of the 'Full workout history' card are tested as data, but no browser test opens a member's page, taps 'Request workout report', sees 'Asking...', the waiting line, the green sent line or 'Download full history', or opens the downloaded file.
expected: A screen test asks for a report, sees each state's line and button, downloads the file and checks a second tap sends no second ask.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the workout report card

title: A failed or half-saved backup download, and staff being kept from it, are never tested
what: Tests only check a download that works. Nothing checks the words when the file cannot be made, that the last-download day does not move after a failure, that a half-saved pair is not called a success, that a double tap starts one download, or that front desk staff get no 'Download a backup' card with every member's phone and address.
expected: Tests make the download fail, save only one file, tap twice, and sign in as staff to see no card.
fix_line: Add failure, double-tap and staff checks to the backup test

title: The Refresh line's hidden tab, busy tap and demo hiding are never tested
what: Tests check the age words and one good and one failed Refresh for the owner. Nothing checks that a tab hidden for minutes reads again when shown and stops reading while hidden, that a second tap while busy starts no second read, that 'Refreshing...' never sticks, or that the demo gym shows no Refresh line. No test signs in as staff for it.
expected: Tests hide and show the tab, tap Refresh twice fast, and open the demo gym to see no line.
fix_line: Add hidden-tab, double-tap and demo checks to the Refresh test

title: Set up your gym's 'Next step' bar and undoing a hand tick are never tested
what: Tests open steps from the list and use 'Back to the list', but never check the 'Next step: ...' bar, that it skips done steps, or that it is missing on screens not opened from the list. Nothing checks that a hand tick can be taken back.
expected: A test follows 'Next step' through two steps and unticks a hand-ticked step.
fix_line: Add the Next step bar and untick to the setup test

title: Two tests lock in that a past special day vanishes without a word
what: The gym timings checks, both in the panel and on the server, require a special day whose date is already over to be dropped quietly on save. The journey says that must never happen without a word, so these tests will fail any fix and keep the silent drop in place.
expected: The tests expect the owner to be told that a special day is already over (or the save to say it was left out).
how_often: every save with an old special day
fix_line: Change both tests to expect a visible word when a past special day is left out

title: Gym timings: Saving, double tap, Keep them and the 30-day cap are never tested
what: The one timings screen test never checks the 'Saving' button, a double tap, the 'Keep them' answer on the remove question, the limit of 30 special days, the 'Pick the one closest' line, or that members see nothing before Save. The failure and offline cards are already listed elsewhere.
expected: The timings screen test also taps Save twice, taps Keep them, tries a 31st special day and checks the Saving state.
fix_line: Add these steps to the existing timings screen test

title: Today's Birthdays and Came in today tiles are never checked on screen
what: No browser test reads the 'Birthdays today' or 'Came in today' tile, opens the register or birthday list from them, checks a brand-new gym shows no wall of zero tiles, or checks that archiving or a check-in moves a tile. These are checked only as counting rules.
expected: A Today screen test checks every tile, the list each one opens, a new gym with no tiles, and the tiles moving after a check-in, an undone visit and an archive.
fix_line: Add a Today tiles screen test for the missing tiles and changes

title: Today tiles are never tested for a gym with two branches
what: No test opens Today on one branch of a two-branch gym, as owner or as a front desk of one branch, and checks that members, money and birthdays of the other branch are left out. The branch test only checks the member list and the 'All branches' page.
expected: A test with two branches checks each branch's Today numbers, and a desk of one branch sees only its own members and no money.
fix_line: Add a two-branch Today test for owner and desk

title: HQ messages in the bell are tested only for the owner
what: The only screen test of HQ messages signs in as the owner. Nothing checks the bell for a front desk or trainer, that a message's button appears only for a page that login may open, that the demo gym shows no HQ messages, that an http link gets no button (only a javascript link is tried), or that an https link opens in a new tab.
expected: Screen tests show an HQ message to staff and a trainer, a button hidden for a page they may not open, the demo gym, and http and https links.
fix_line: Add staff, trainer, demo and link cases to the HQ message tests

title: Importing members into several branches is never tried on screen
what: Every check of a branch import is a rule check. No browser test shows 'Branches in your file', the pick for an unknown name, 'Skip these rows', the per-sheet branch pick, the result branch by branch, or the line saying each branch has its own Past imports.
expected: A screen test imports one file into two branches, picks a branch for an unknown name, skips one, and undoes in one branch.
fix_line: Add one screen test of a two-branch import

title: Some ways an Aadhaar number could slip into an import are never tested
what: No test fixes a row under 'Rows to check' and checks the ID number is still cut, imports the same file twice and compares, writes an Aadhaar in Hindi digits or odd separators, or checks that the skipped-rows download has no ID number. expected: Tests cover the fixed row, the second import, Hindi-digit and odd-separator Aadhaar numbers, and the skipped-rows file.
fix_line: Add these four cases to the ID number tests

title: Import refusals and the fill-in-blanks choice are never seen on screen
what: No test shows the over-5 MB line, the not-an-Excel line, the first-2000-rows line, the 'Skip them / Fill in their blank details' choice, the 'Update' button words, 'Reading the file', or the sheet pick for a workbook. They are checked only as rules or not at all.
expected: Screen tests pick a too-big file, a wrong file, a 2001-row file, a file with existing members (fill in blanks) and a workbook with two sheets.
fix_line: Add these files to the import screen tests

title: The member card is never opened on screen by any test
what: Only the card's facts are checked as data. No test opens the card, prints it, saves the picture or opens WhatsApp from it. The printed page without the panel's menu, the card on one page, the initials in place of a missing photo and the end of the WhatsApp words are never seen.
expected: A screen test opens a member's card as owner and as desk, prints it, saves the picture and checks the WhatsApp words in full.
fix_line: Add one screen test that opens, prints, saves and shares a member card

title: Taking a photo on a member's page is never tested on screen
what: The camera sheet on a saved member's page is never opened by a test. The live preview, the camera trouble messages in full, the file messages in full, the new photo on the list and card, and the camera light going off are never seen. Only helper results and the server's answers are checked.
expected: A screen test with a fake camera takes, uploads, replaces and removes a member photo and checks each trouble message.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the member photo sheet with a fake camera

what: Questions and messages are counted, not listed, and each waiting one is named only by its place in the count. If one is answered and a new one comes in, the count is the same, so nothing looks new and no sound plays. No test tries this; the only test raises the count.
expected: A new question or message always rings once, even when another was answered in the same minute, and a test proves it.

title: Undo import is never tested for a member the gym only edited, a cancelled receipt, or a second undo

expected: Tests prove an edited member and a cancelled imported receipt are kept, and a second undo removes nothing kept.

title: The not-a-spreadsheet message and the same result from CSV and Excel are never checked

expected: The journeys and the tests agree on what the progress list shows and where the ready words go.

title: The words for a member who does not share workouts are never checked

expected: A screen test opens a non-sharing member and a member who just switched off, and checks the words and that no figures remain.

title: The phone More page is never checked for the desk, nor compared with the side menu

expected: A test opens More and the side menu for owner and desk and finds the same rows in the same order.

title: The Add member joining date is never checked near midnight in India

expected: A test with the clock just after midnight in India shows today's date as the joining date.

title: The 'Your gym is ready' card is only checked for its title and Done button
what: Every online-gym test passes the card by checking its title and first sentence, then pressing Done. Nothing checks the gym code, the join link, the QR, the copy messages, the share or WhatsApp step, the poster button, or that an ordinary sign-in shows no card.
expected: A screen test reads the code and link on the card, copies each, presses the poster button and signs in again to see no card.
