title: The Today cards for numbers to confirm and app plan requests are never used on screen
what: The words, the error sentences and the server rules of both cards are tested, but no test opens Today with a waiting number or a pause or renew request and presses Yes, No, Approve or Decline. 'Saving…', the buttons switching off, the row leaving, the Needs you count dropping and the card hiding are never seen.
expected: One screen test per card answers a waiting row as the owner and checks the row, the count and the card.
fix_line: Add a screen test that answers one waiting number and one plan request

title: Marking and taking back a PT session is never done on screen
what: The session rules are tested as data and on the server, but no screen test presses Mark session or Undo. 'PT session marked.', 'Session marked today', '2 PT packs running…', the 'Only 1 PT session left' words and the Undo button being hidden from the desk for an older day are never checked.
expected: A screen test marks a session, sees the count go up and the button turn off, undoes it, and checks the desk sees no Undo for an older day.
fix_line: Add a screen test for Mark session and Undo on a PT member

title: The empty Pass visits page and the one-visit export words are never checked
what: The pass test checks a month with two visits and 'Exported 2 pass visits.'. Nothing checks the words for one visit, the empty month words, or that a gym with no pass members has no Pass visits entry. No test does a pass visit as the front desk.
expected: A test checks 'Exported 1 pass visit.', the empty month words and the hidden entry.
fix_line: Add the one-visit and empty-month checks to the pass test

title: Printing a receipt is never tested
what: No test opens the print view of a receipt. Nothing checks that only the receipt sheet prints, that the buttons and menu stay off the paper, or that a second print keeps the same number.
expected: A test prints a receipt and checks the paper shows only the receipt, with the same number each time.
fix_line: Add one print-view check to the receipt test

title: Ready-made challenge cards: saving, failures and blocked states are never seen in a test
what: The challenge test turns cards on and off on the happy path only. No test shows the Saving button with the others greyed, a failed save, the 'not switched on yet' card, the 60-day blocked line, the offline button, a turned-off card after a refresh, or a second run starting from zero.
expected: A test drives each of these states and checks the words and that nothing is saved.
fix_line: Add screen checks for the failure and blocked states

title: The 'Joined online' card is never tested as the front desk, and its error lines never at all
what: Every Joined online test signs in as the owner. The desk is the one who usually makes these people members, yet no test does it as the desk, checks the receipt names the desk person, or shows the lines for someone else approving, could not approve, could not check the payment, or a name that could not be saved.
expected: A test signs in as front desk staff, approves and makes a member, and drives each error line.
fix_line: Add a desk run of the Joined online card with its error lines

title: The Android 'Install the admin app' button is never tested, and no test shows the card to staff
what: Every install-card test runs with no install offer from the browser, so the card only ever shows 'Show me how'. The Install button, Chrome's install sheet and the card leaving after install are never checked, and no test signs in as staff to see the card.
expected: A test fakes the browser's install offer, taps Install, and checks the card goes; one run as staff.
fix_line: Fake the install offer in the install-card test

title: Quick buttons: the desk view, the six-button limit and an empty list are never seen on screen
what: The only screen test is the owner adding one button. Nothing signs in as the desk to check hidden buttons and no Change link, and nothing shows the greyed rows at six, the empty list, the sheet sentence or the Expenses page opening.
expected: A test checks the desk's buttons and the sheet's limits on screen.
fix_line: Add a desk run and a six-button run to the quick buttons test

title: Most lines under settings are checked only as text in the code, not on screen
what: The setting-lines test reads the sentences and searches the screen code for their names. Only three lines are ever seen on screen. The branch wording, the web-page wording, the UPI line and the tick-box lines are never seen under their setting.
expected: A screen test opens each settings tab and checks the line under each setting, in a branch too.
fix_line: Add one screen walk through the settings tabs

title: Free days for a friend: refusals, failed save and the desk's view are never seen on screen
what: The friend test covers the happy path. The 'not on your member list' and 'no plan running' sentences, the 'No free days' toast, a failed save, the desk opening a referred enquiry, and the reward line on the receipt are never seen on screen.
expected: A test drives each refusal and the desk view on screen.
fix_line: Add the refusal cases to the friend test

title: The paid-online journey expects a Make member button that the card does not show
what: The journey says a paid-online row shows both Approve and Make member. The code shows only Approve, and the test checks Make member is absent. The journey line is wrong, so a later reader may report a bug that is not there.
expected: The journey says the paid row shows Approve only.
fix_line: Correct the journey line to Approve only

title: The Monday WhatsApp summary is never checked for privacy, an empty gym or the desk
what: One screen test taps Share on WhatsApp in the demo gym and checks three lines. Nothing checks that the message carries no member name or phone number, the My gym and zero lines for a new gym, that the card hides on other weekdays on screen, or that the desk never sees the card and its money totals.
expected: A screen test reads the whole message for an empty gym and a busy one, proves no member name or number is in it, and signs in as the desk to see no card.
fix_line: Extend the Monday test with an empty gym, a name check and a desk sign-in

title: What is new and its bell number are tested only as the owner, and never in the demo gym
what: Both What is new screen tests sign in as the owner. No test opens the bell or the What is new page as the front desk or a trainer, and none checks that the demo gym shows no update number. The page heading line with the version is never read.
expected: A screen test signs in as the desk, sees the update number and the page without owner-only buttons, and the demo gym shows no update number.
fix_line: Add a desk sign-in and a demo gym check to the What is new test

title: The member WhatsApp sheet never checks the number it opens, a short number, or the desk
what: Tests read the ready words in the member WhatsApp sheet, but no test presses Send and checks that WhatsApp opens on this member number. The warning for a mobile number that is not complete, the Plan ending one-by-one list, switching language and the sheet used by the front desk are never tested.
expected: A screen test sends from the sheet and checks the WhatsApp address carries this member number only, shows the short-number warning with no send button, walks the one-by-one list with a skip, and repeats as the desk.
fix_line: Add a sheet test that presses Send, tries a short number and runs as the desk

title: The paid-plan reminder on Today is never seen on screen, nor the desk Today of a trial gym
what: The line asking a paying gym to pay for the next month or year, and the line after its paid-until day, are only checked as words. No screen test shows them with their two links. No test opens Today as the front desk of a trial gym to see that no trial or payment line shows.
expected: A screen test sets a paid-until day 5 days ahead and then past, sees both lines with Pay MettleUp and See prices, and signs in as the desk to see no line.
fix_line: Add the paid-until line and a desk Today to the trial test

title: The Workout offer card on Today, the offline card and the no-receipt promise are never tested
what: No test shows the Today card that says how many rewards wait to be given, for the owner or the desk. The Workout offers need your gym online card, the Starting button and the promise that free days make no receipt and no GST are never checked.
expected: A screen test shows the Today card with 1 and then 2 rewards, taps Give, sees the card go; an offline gym shows its card; and after a reward no new receipt exists.
fix_line: Extend the offer test with the Today card, an offline gym and a receipt count

title: The desk never turns its own alerts on or off in a test, and the could-not-turn-on words are never seen
what: The alerts test signs in as the desk only to read the timing words. No test has the desk turn alerts on, off and on again on its own device, checks the owner device stays on, or shows Alerts could not be turned on when saving fails.
expected: A screen test has the desk switch its own alerts off and on, checks the owner device is untouched and only one address is kept, and shows the failure words when the save fails.
fix_line: Add a desk on-off round and a failed save to the alerts test

title: The Visits register is never used in a test signed in as the front desk
what: Every screen test of checking members in, removing a check-in, back-dating a day and the Pass visits page signs in as the owner. The desk does this every morning, but no test signs in as desk staff and opens Visits or Losing the habit. Only the menu list for the desk is checked.
expected: At least one screen test signs in as desk staff, checks a member in, undoes it, adds a missed day and opens Losing the habit.
fix_line: Repeat the register test once signed in as desk staff

title: No test checks when the Pass visits button hides or stays
what: The only test taps Pass visits on a gym that has pass members. Nothing checks that a gym with no pass member sees only Check-in QR, that the button appears when the first pass member is added, or that it stays after the last pass member is archived because past visits exist.
expected: A test covers a gym with no pass member, the first pass member added, and the last one archived.
fix_line: Add a short test for the three button states

title: Bring a friend: clearing the days, the one-day wording and the greyed Save are never tested
what: The test sets 7 free days and checks one wrong number. It never clears the box back to none, never saves 1 day (where the toast must say "1 free day"), never checks that Save greys when nothing changed, and never checks the card is hidden on a gym that is not online.
expected: The test also saves an empty box (reads "None"), saves 1 day, checks the greyed Save and the offline gym.
fix_line: Add the empty, one-day and no-change steps to the friend test

title: Several register lines are never checked on the Visits screen
what: The register test checks the toast, the today tile and the missed-day strip. It never checks that the search box empties, that the member shows under "In today", the other three tiles, "Nobody matches that" with "Open Members" on the register, or the batch list for a missed day with its A to Z order.
expected: The register test checks these lines too.
fix_line: Add these checks to the existing register test

title: A test keeps an entry machine Online for three minutes after it stops, while the journey says it must not stay Online for minutes
what: The journey for the entry machine card says the pill turns Offline within about 30 seconds and must never stay Online for minutes after the machine stops. The test of the status rule says a machine is still Online exactly 3 minutes after its last call. So either the journey or the rule is wrong, and the test locks in the rule.
expected: The journey and the test agree on how long a silent machine may still show Online.
how_often: every time a machine loses its internet
fix_line: Decide the right time, then fix the journey or the rule and its test to match

title: The owner-only rule and the number rules for entry machines are checked only by reading the server change's text
what: The checks that only the owner can add or remove a machine, and that a taken number or another gym's serial is refused, read the words of a database change that is marked not applied. Nothing runs that change against a database, so a wrong rule would still pass.
expected: A database test that runs the entry machine calls as owner, staff and a second gym and checks the refusals.
fix_line: Add a database test that calls the entry machine functions as each role once the change goes live

title: Many entry machine screens are never tested: the staff view, the no-number card, Keep it, the reload, Try again
what: The one browser test of entry machines is signed in as the owner. It never shows the screen to staff, never shows 'No machine number yet' or 'Give a number' (it gives every member a number first), never presses 'Keep it', never reloads after a remove, and never shows the failed-read or gym-not-online messages on screen. The pill changing by itself is never watched.
expected: A browser test covers each of these states for the owner and for staff.
fix_line: Add browser steps for the staff view, the no-number card, Keep it, a reload and the error states

title: The WhatsApp and Call buttons on Enquiries are never pressed in a test
what: No test presses WhatsApp on an enquiry or a referred friend, or reads the Call link's number. So nothing checks that the message names the gym, goes to that person's number only, opens without sending by itself, or that the number has its country code.
expected: A browser test presses Call and WhatsApp on an ordinary, a referred and a web chat enquiry and checks the number and message.
fix_line: Add test steps that press Call and WhatsApp and check the address

title: The Add enquiry warnings, refusals, Saving and failed save are never seen on screen
what: The tests fill the Add enquiry sheet only on the happy path. 'Type their name.', the warning that someone already asked from this number, 'Use at most <n> letters.', 'No date: it goes under Later.', the Saving button, a failed save keeping the typed values, a double press and the empty-list words are never checked on screen.
expected: A browser test drives each of these on the Add enquiry sheet.
fix_line: Add browser steps for the Add enquiry refusals, warnings and failed save

title: The 'Why did they not join?' reason box is never tested
what: The not-interested test checks the bar, the move and Reopen, but never picks a reason, never checks that 'Add as member' and 'Follow-up date' leave the row, and never checks that a reopened enquiry loses its reason.
expected: A browser test picks a reason, checks it stays on that enquiry only, and checks it is cleared on Reopen.
fix_line: Add steps for the reason box and Reopen clearing it

title: The thank-you sheet's failure, cannot-give notes and staff view are checked only as data
what: The free days thank-you is tested on screen only when it works. The red line after a failed save and the retry, the notes for an inviter who is not on the list or has no plan, the inviter with no plan getting no sheet, and staff seeing no give button are only checked inside the logic, never on screen.
expected: A browser test shows each of these states, including as staff.
fix_line: Add browser steps for the failed save, the cannot-give notes and the staff view

title: Help and feedback's AI answer, its Yes and No and the team's reply are never seen on screen
what: Sending…, 'Waiting for the answer', the AI answer with 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.', 'Did this solve it?' with Yes and No and their thanks, and the team's reply with its New mark are only checked in the logic. The real-gym screen test reaches only the help pages' answer.
expected: A browser test in a real gym sends a question, gets an AI answer, taps Yes or No, and sees a team reply marked New once.
fix_line: Add a browser test of the AI answer, the rating and a team reply

title: The MettleUp access card's off, failed and Cancel states are never seen on screen
what: The browser tests only open and close support access. 'MettleUp access is not switched on for your gym yet.', a failed read of the list with the ask button blocked, Cancel on the sheet, and a refused open are never shown in a test.
expected: A browser test shows each of these states and checks nothing opens.
fix_line: Add browser steps for the switched-off card, a failed list, Cancel and a refused open

title: The timings test requires 'Right now members see' before anything is saved
what: The one screen test for gym timings picks a ready-made week and, before Save is ever tapped, requires the top line to read 'Right now members see: Open now'. Members see nothing yet at that moment. So the test locks in the wrong line already reported, and a fix would turn the test red.
expected: Before the first save the line says what members will see once saved, and the test checks those words instead.
fix_line: Change the test to expect the not-saved-yet wording together with the screen fix

title: The skipped-rows download copies Aadhaar numbers as they were, and no test notices
what: When an import file has an Aadhaar or PAN column, the screen says ID numbers are never imported. But the 'Download skipped rows' file writes every skipped row back out cell by cell, exactly as it was in the file, ID column included. The file check only looks at the reason column. A gym that downloads the skipped rows gets a fresh file of members' Aadhaar numbers.
expected: The skipped-rows file leaves out or blanks any column found to hold ID numbers, and ID numbers inside other cells, and a test checks that.
how_often: every import with an ID column and a skipped row
fix_line: Blank the ID columns in the skipped-rows file and add a test for it

title: Gym timings for a gym with two branches are never tested
what: No test opens Gym timings in a gym with two branches. Nothing checks the 'Each branch has its own timings' line, that each branch keeps its own week, or that members of one branch never see the other branch's hours. The server test only tries a second, unrelated gym.
expected: A test saves different timings in two branches and checks each branch, and each branch's members, see their own.
fix_line: Add a two-branch case to the timings tests

title: Most of the member page is never checked by a test
what: Tests touch the member page only for the Dues tile, the plan dates and a few empty lines. Nothing checks 'Member since', the status pill, the Training pattern card, the Details card fields, editing a field and seeing it kept after a refresh, the 'Check this member' note for a shared mobile with its 'Checked' button, or the 'Member not found' page for a bad link.
expected: Tests open a full member page and check each card, edit one field and refresh, open a bad member link, and clear a possible-double note.
fix_line: Add a member page test that reads every card and the not-found page

title: The member page is never checked as the front desk, apart from the money buttons
what: Only one test opens a member page signed in as the front desk, and it only checks that the cancel and extra-days buttons are gone. No front-desk test reads the tiles and cards, a pass member's page, a new member's empty page, checks a member in from the page, opens the member card or shares the app link.
expected: A front-desk test opens a member with a plan, a pass member and a new member, checks them in, opens the card and shares the link.
fix_line: Add a front-desk run through the member page

title: Checking in from the member page: the toast, a failure and the next day are never tested
what: Tests see 'Checked in today' on the member page, but never the 'Saving…' state, the 'Checked in for today.' toast, the red banner when the save fails with the button coming back, a member already checked in by the poster, or the button turning back to 'Check in' the next day.
expected: A test taps Check in on the member page, reads the toast, makes one save fail, and moves the clock to the next day.
fix_line: Add these steps to a member page check-in test

title: Archiving offline, a failed archive and reminders after archiving are never tested
what: No test archives a member without internet, makes an archive fail, or checks that expiry and dues reminders stop going to an archived member. Restoring is already listed as untested elsewhere.
expected: Tests archive offline and on a failing server and see the pill and button not change, and check that an archived member drops off the reminder lists.
fix_line: Add offline, failure and reminder checks to the archive test

title: Import progress words and a second tap on Add are never tested
what: No test checks 'Reading the file…', 'Adding members…', the '<done> of <total> done. Keep this page open' line, that the back button hides while it runs, the 'rows are not saved yet' line after a stop, or that a second tap on Add starts nothing.
expected: The import test reads the progress lines during a slow save and taps Add twice.
fix_line: Add progress and double-tap checks to the import test

title: AI column matching: the waiting line, a late answer and the owner's own pick are never tested
what: Tests check the AI's finished line, but never 'Matching your columns with AI…', the '· Matched by AI' tag on a box, a box the owner set while the AI was still working, an answer that arrives after the owner moved to a new header row or another sheet, or the tag leaving a box the owner changed.
expected: Tests hold the AI answer back, change a box and the sheet meanwhile, then let it arrive and check the owner's choices stand.

title: Importing a file with several sheets is never tested on screen

expected: A test imports a three-sheet file, adds the first sheet, then the next from the finished card.
fix_line: Add a three-sheet workbook to the import tests

title: A test requires a past start day to be saved; the journey says it never is
what: The journey for Change start date says a start day in the past must never be saved. The test of the same rule saves a start about a month back and passes, and the rule allows up to 31 days back on purpose.
expected: The journey and the test agree: either a past start is refused, or the journey says up to 31 days back is allowed.
fix_line: Decide the rule, then fix the journey line or the test

title: The WhatsApp sheet on a member page is barely tested, and never as the desk
what: One screen test opens the sheet as the owner and reads the ready message. No test sees the red box for a half mobile number, the greyed "needs internet" link, the language pick being remembered, the hand-changed text going back on reopen, or WhatsApp opening on this member's number. No test opens it signed in as the desk.
expected: A screen test for each of those, for the owner and the desk.
fix_line: Add one phone test of the sheet for the owner and one for the desk

title: Sending a workout plan from a member page is never done on screen
what: The rules behind it are tested as data: which plans are already sent, Undo, and a clash with another desk. No test opens "Send a plan" on a member page, taps Send, sees the Undo bar, the "Already sent" row, the greyed offline button or the not-online card words, for any role.
expected: A screen test that sends a plan, undoes it and sees "Already sent", as the owner, the desk and a trainer.

title: Parts of cancelling a membership are never checked on screen
what: The one test cancels and undoes a renewal as the owner. It never checks the "unpaid, not in dues" line on the row, the Keep it button, the Saving button, the greyed offline button, the dues tile after the cancel of a part-paid plan, or that a second cancel after an undo keeps the new reason.
expected: The test checks each of those lines.
fix_line: Extend the cancel test with a part-paid plan and a second cancel

title: No screen test taps Save twice on the money sheets of a member page
what: The rule that one press makes one receipt is tested in the data store only. No phone test checks that the Sell, Collect or Cancel receipt button reads "Saving…" or "Cancelling…" and cannot be pressed again, or that two fast taps make one sale and one receipt.
expected: A phone test double-taps each money sheet and finds one sale or receipt and the busy button.

title: The measurements card for a gym not online, and a long list of entries, are never tested
what: No test opens a member page in a gym that is not online and checks "Put your gym online first" with no Add button. No test has five or more entries to check the full list then the newest four, or sees "Keep them" and "Deleting…".
expected: Screen tests for the not-online card and a member with five or more entries.
fix_line: Add the two cases to the measurements phone test

title: Member messages: a double tap, the sending state, the page refreshing by itself, the empty page and the 180-day line are never tested
what: The Member messages screen test sends one reply as the owner and marks one message done. No test taps Send reply twice, checks the Sending state with both buttons greyed, waits for the page to read the list again by itself, opens the page with no messages, or looks for the line saying messages are deleted after 180 days. The front desk and a trainer never reply or mark done on screen; only the server checks cover that.
expected: Screen tests cover a double tap on Send reply, the Sending state, the refresh by itself without wiping a reply being typed, the empty page for the owner and the trainer, the 180-day line, and the desk and a trainer marking a message done.
fix_line: Add screen checks for the double tap, the sending state, the refresh by itself, the empty page, the 180-day line and staff marking done

title: The Members list chips, the 'Has dues' list and its 'WhatsApp all, one by one' sheet are never tested on screen
what: No screen test checks the chip counts on Members against the rows, that 'Has dues' includes archived members who owe money, that a home tile opens the list with its own chip, or that a renewal moves a member between Expired and Active. expected: Screen tests compare each chip with its rows, open 'Has dues' with an archived member who owes, follow a home tile into Members, use the one-by-one sheet, and open Members as the front desk.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the Members chips, Has dues with an archived member, a home tile, the one-by-one sheet and the desk view

title: The 'Joined in the app' tab is only tested for two taps
what: One test taps an app member to open their page and taps another to open Add member. Nothing checks the gym code line, the orders and shop money on each card, the empty page, the not-online card, a failed read, the list refreshing by itself, that the add form comes with the name and number filled in, or what the front desk sees on this tab.
expected: Screen tests check the card lines, the empty, not-online and failed-read pages, the refresh by itself, the filled-in add form, and the tab as the front desk.

title: A past time for a timed message, sending when nobody has the app, and a failed send are never tested
what: The timed message test picks tomorrow 9 am and checks the words. expected: Screen tests refuse a past time, show the Timed pill, send with no member in the app, show the limit warning, and show a failed send followed by the Sent list read again.
fix_line: Add screen tests for a past time, nobody in the app, the limit warning and a failed send

title: The workout offer's 'Part of the Pro pack' card, 'already has the reward' and a removed member are never tested
what: No test opens the Workout offer on a Starter gym, so the Pro pack card and its how-to-move words are never seen, by the owner or the desk. The note when a member already has the reward, and the row for a member removed from the list, are never checked.
expected: Screen tests open the Workout offer on a Starter gym as owner and desk, give a reward twice, and show a removed member's row without their name.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the Pro pack card, a second give and a removed member

title: The receipt for a payment to MettleUp is never opened in a test
what: Only the server and a reading helper check the MettleUp receipt's figures. No test opens the receipt page and checks its lines, the Back to Pay MettleUp button, the print view, the 'Receipt not found' page for a wrong number or another gym, or what the desk and the demo see.
expected: A screen test opens a MettleUp receipt and checks every line, prints it, and opens a wrong number and another gym's number.

title: The More page's Shop and Member questions badges and its rows for a trainer are never tested

title: The Member questions page is checked on the server but almost never on screen

expected: The reply flow and each empty, refused and error state of Member questions is seen on screen, for the owner and for a trainer.

title: Training progress is never tested when it cannot show, or for a trainer opening full progress

title: Pause my plan and Renew my plan are never used on a phone in any test
what: The day picking rules, the request lines and the server's rules are tested as data. No phone test opens the pause sheet, taps two days, sends, takes the request back, taps 'Got it', or checks that 'Request sent' does not show when the send fails or the phone is offline.
expected: A phone test sends a pause and a renew request on a test gym, takes one back, and tries one offline.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the pause and renew requests, including offline

title: The 'Send your report to the gym?' card is never shown on a phone, and a failed upload is never tried
what: Which workouts go into the report and the server's rules are tested. No test shows the card, 'Sending your report...', 'Report sent to the gym.', 'OK. Nothing was sent to the gym.', or the 'Try again' card after a yes whose file did not arrive. Nothing checks that 'sent' is not shown when the upload fails.
expected: A phone test answers yes and no to a report request from a test gym, and one with the upload failing.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the report card: yes, no and a failed upload

title: The workout offer card and its consent screen are never used on a phone, and the offer pop-up is never tapped
what: The card and consent words and what may leave the phone are tested as data. No phone test shows the offer card, opens the consent screen, taps 'Join the offer' or 'Not now', or taps the offer pop-up to check it lands on the card without skipping consent. 'Not now' writing nothing and the words for one extra day or one visit ('1 extra days', '1 times') are never tried.
expected: A phone test joins and declines an offer on a test gym, and opens it from the pop-up.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the offer card, consent, Not now and the pop-up tap

title: After leaving a gym, no test checks the kept gym hours are forgotten, or a new gym joined while an old leave still waits
what: Leaving is tested on screen and the offer and name switch are forgotten, but no test checks the phone forgets the gym's kept opening hours. No test opens a new invite link while an old leave is still waiting to be sent, to check the new link stays and the old leave still goes.
expected: Tests check the kept hours are gone after leaving, and that a fresh link and an old waiting leave both work.
fix_line: Add tests for the hours copy after leaving and a new link while a leave waits

title: The question box's 500-letter counter, the empty question line and a double tap are never tested
what: The refusal words are tested as data. No test types past 500 letters, sends an empty question to see 'Please type your question first.', or taps send twice to check only one question goes.
expected: A phone test types too much, sends nothing, and taps send twice on the question page.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the question box limits and a double tap

title: A member moved to a pass while an old paid plan still runs is never tried on the phone
what: The pass member phone test first cancels the member's paid plan, then gives a stand-in plan that the test build reads as the pass. So the case the journey names, a real old plan still running beside the pass, is never seen on screen, nor a waiting request kept after the move.
expected: A phone test moves a member with a running plan and a waiting request to a pass, and checks the pass words win and the request still shows.
fix_line: Add a phone test with a running plan kept beside the pass

title: The phone tests pass even if the 'put your gym on the home screen' pop-up never appears
what: Both phone flows that meet the pop-up after a join wait for it as optional and check it only when it happens to show. If the pop-up broke and never appeared, both flows would still pass. Its later screens ('Tap Add on your phone's question', 'Last step: remove the MettleUp icon', 'Not added') are never shown on a phone at all.
expected: For a gym with a logo the test should fail when the pop-up does not appear, and the add, last-step and not-added screens should each be seen once.
fix_line: Make the pop-up check required in the branded-gym flow and add one flow through each of its three later screens

title: The trainer's video row is never shown or tapped in any test
what: Tests check only which links count as YouTube and how a video is matched to an exercise. No test draws the 'Watch your trainer' row, taps it to open YouTube, shows 'Couldn't open the video' when offline, or checks that the row goes after the trainer removes the video or the member leaves the gym.
expected: A test should show the row on an exercise page, open the link outside the app, show the offline notice, and prove a removed video or an old gym's video is no longer offered.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the exercise page with and without a video, and a forget-on-leave check

title: 'Messaging your gym is not ready yet' is never tested
what: No test, word table or phone flow checks what the Message your gym page shows when the gym's server does not have messaging yet. The only related check is that the unread count is zero then.
expected: A test should show the 'not ready yet' words and no send box on a server without messaging.
fix_line: Add one check of the page on a server without messaging

title: The 'Recommend MettleUp to my gym' card is never checked to hide inside a gym or come back after leaving
what: Tests check only the link and that the card's words mention running a gym and free. Nothing checks the card's full words, that it is hidden for a member inside a MettleUp gym, that it returns after leaving, or that cancelling the share menu leaves the screen as it was.
expected: A test should show the card on the no-gym screen with its words, prove it is gone after a join and back after leaving, and that a cancelled share shows no error.
fix_line: Add the card to an existing no-gym phone flow and to a join-then-leave flow

title: No test proves the Gym tab home shows only this gym's data and sends nothing extra
what: Tests check the header's size and the parts' order. Nothing checks that the Gym tab home holds only the joined gym's public name, logo and parts, or what the phone sends to the gym when it checks that the member is still joined.
expected: A test should prove another gym's data never appears and the still-joined check sends only the member's own key.
fix_line: Add one check of what the still-joined call sends and one with two gyms' data

title: Find my gym is tested only with a made-up answer, never with the WhatsApp step
what: Every phone flow for Find my gym and phone sign-in uses the test build's made-up answer, so the WhatsApp message, 'Send the message in WhatsApp', 'Looking for your gym...', a wrong sending number, 'checked too many times today' and the time-out with the typed values kept are never seen on a phone. The card itself shows only when MettleUp Plus is switched on, which the store build has off. Several journey words ('We check your number against...', 'We look only for a plan that runs today...', 'may contact your gym') are asserted nowhere.
expected: At least the screens after each server answer should be drawn in a test, and the exact words the journeys promise should be checked once.
fix_line: Add a stand-in for each server answer (wrong number, too many, expired) and assert the promised words

title: Bring a friend's count is never checked to stay at 0 before a friend joins, or to go back down
what: The server test checks the count is 1 after the desk marks the friend joined. It never checks that a friend who only left a number leaves the count at 0, or that the count goes down when the join is undone. No test checks the share menu opens only once on a fast double tap.
expected: The server test should read the count after the friend's page is sent and after the join is undone; a phone check should tap Invite twice quickly.
fix_line: Add two count reads to the bring-a-friend server test and a double-tap check

title: The first-routine test locks in the 'Skip for now' words that promise a return that never comes
what: The test requires the skip button to say 'Skip for now' and also requires a skip to hide the card for good. It passes on the very fault already found, and will fail whoever fixes the words.
expected: The test checks that the skip words match what happens: either the card comes back later, or the button says it will not.
fix_line: Change the test with the words fix so it asks for words that match the behaviour

title: No test checks the day calendar refuses future days or keeps the picked day
what: The month calendar used for a workout's day and a weigh-in's day has no test of its own. Nothing checks that future days are greyed out, that the next-month arrow stops at this month, or that a picked day stays picked when the calendar opens again.
expected: A test taps a future day and the next-month arrow and sees nothing change, and reopens the calendar to see the picked day still selected.
how_often: every past workout or weigh-in dated by hand
fix_line: Add one small test of the calendar's day rules and one phone step tapping a future day

title: Undo of a deleted set and the 'Remove exercise?' question are never tested
what: In a live workout, putting back a deleted set with Undo has no test at all, so nothing checks it returns to its place or that Undo is withdrawn after a change. The 'Remove exercise?' question and its Cancel are never checked either; only the rest ending is.
expected: A test deletes a set, taps Undo and sees it back in its place; another removes an exercise, sees the question, cancels and keeps the sets, then confirms and sees it left out on Finish.
how_often: whenever a member deletes a set or removes an exercise
fix_line: Add store tests for set undo and a phone step for the remove question

title: The finish sheet's empty-workout and only-unticked cases are never tested
what: No test checks that a workout with no sets shows a greyed 'Tick a set to finish' and cannot be saved empty, that a workout with only unticked sets picks 'Save them' by itself, or that the choice and note boxes reset when the sheet opens again.
expected: Tests open the finish sheet with no sets and with only unticked sets and check the button, the picked choice and the empty boxes on reopening.
fix_line: Add tests for the two edge cases and the reset

title: The how-to sheet is never opened from a live workout, and the member's own photo or video in it is never checked
what: The demo sheet is only opened from the exercise page in tests. Nothing checks it from a live workout (back on the same workout, timer and sets kept), that the exercise page shows the picture without steps twice, that the member's own video or photo shows instead of the library clip, or that a broken own photo falls back.
expected: A phone step opens the sheet from a live workout and closes it, and one checks an exercise with its own photo.
how_often: every look at a how-to during a workout
fix_line: Add a phone step from a live workout and an own-photo check

title: No test checks records stay away for a never-logged exercise or an impossible run time
what: Nothing checks that an exercise never logged shows no records section and no 0 kg record, or that a typo like 2 km in 30 seconds is not shown as the best pace.
expected: Tests feed an empty history and an impossible run set and see no records and no pace record.
fix_line: Add two small record tests

title: The chart's free-plan limit and its empty range are never tested
what: No test checks that a free member asking for an older chart range gets the Plus pop-up and stays on 3 months, that a gym member with an active plan is not locked, or that a range with nothing shows a dash and 'Nothing in this range yet' instead of a flat line.
expected: Tests pick an older range as a free member, as a gym member, and on an empty range, and check what shows.
how_often: every free member opening a chart
fix_line: Add chart tests for the limit and the empty range

title: The workout clock's m:ss form and its 0:00 before start are never checked
what: Tests check the paused-time sums and the 'WORKOUT DURATION' title, but nothing checks the clock reads like '12:05', not '12m 05s', or that it stands at 0:00 before the workout starts.
expected: A small test of the clock text, running and not yet started.
fix_line: Add a clock text test

title: No test checks the body map or the kg to beat change after a new or deleted workout
what: The body map shading and the Start screen's kilos to beat are only tested on fixed numbers. Nothing checks they update after a new workout, go back after one is deleted, or that the Ready screen draws the figure picked in Profile.
expected: A test adds then deletes a workout and sees the shading and the kilos to beat change and change back.
fix_line: Add one refresh test for each

title: The plank timer's countdown is never tested
what: No automated test runs the countdown from a goal time: it never checks the set saving itself at zero with the goal time, the 5-second floor, the greyed save before one second, or the Keep / Discard / Keep going question. The one phone test only starts a stopwatch, taps save and takes a picture.
expected: A test that starts a countdown, lets it reach zero and checks the set is ticked once with the goal time, plus the floor, the greyed save and the stop question.
fix_line: Add a test that runs a short countdown to zero and checks the saved time and tick, and one for the stop question

title: A test locks in the quiet fallback the Weight step journey forbids
what: The journey says a saved Weight step value the app does not know must not quietly turn into another choice. The test asserts the opposite: an unknown saved value falls back to Standard with no word to the member.
expected: Either the journey or the app decides: if quiet fallback is wanted, the journey line goes; if not, the app says so and the test checks that.
fix_line: Pick one rule for an unknown saved setting and make the journey and the test say the same

title: The import privacy promises are never tested
what: Nothing checks that a Hevy or Strong file stays on the phone, that the Hevy link page is read in a hidden private browser that keeps nothing and asks for no sign-in, or that imported workouts reach Health Connect only as the member's setting allows.
expected: Tests that the import sends nothing to a MettleUp server, that the link reader stays private, and that a member who chose not to send past workouts gets none sent.
fix_line: Add tests for the three privacy promises of the import

title: When saving a routine change fails, no test checks what the member sees
what: Two failure paths have no test: a new routine that could not be made ('Could not create routine'), and a muscle tip whose Add or Swap fails ('Couldn't add it', 'Your routine has changed'). Nothing checks that no half-made routine or half-done swap is left and that the tip stays.
expected: A test per failure that forces the save to fail and checks the message, that nothing changed, and that the tip or Routines tab is as before.
fix_line: Add failure tests for making a routine and for a muscle tip's Add and Swap

title: The folder and workout name sheet is barely tested
what: Making a new folder, renaming a past workout, a blank name, the 60-letter limit, a double tap and cancelling a half-typed name have no test. Only renaming a folder is driven once, without checking the result.
expected: Tests for a new folder (no blank, no double, trimmed), the workout rename and its failure message, and a cancelled edit leaving the old name.
fix_line: Add a short phone test for new folder and workout rename, and unit checks for the blank and long name

title: The month's 'Days you trained' calendar is only photographed
what: The phone test scrolls to the calendar and takes a picture; nothing checks the filled days, the heading count, the today ring, a finished month, the empty month or a deleted workout. Only the list of trained dates is checked as data.
expected: Tests that the heading count matches the filled days, the first of the month sits on the right weekday, the empty month shows its words, and deleting a day's only workout clears it.
fix_line: Add checks on the calendar's filled days and the empty-month words

title: No test checks that a backdated workout stays out of the gym's numbers
what: A member can log a past workout dated before they joined a gym. No test checks that such a workout is left out of the gym's figures for that member, or that it cannot win an offer or move them up the board when the gym's rules leave it out.
expected: A test that logs a workout dated before the join day and checks the gym figures, offers and board ignore it.
fix_line: Add a test that a workout dated before joining never counts for the gym

title: The 'Rest alerts' fix row is never tapped or read by a phone test
what: The phone test only photographs Settings with or without the 'May be late' row and asserts nothing; no test taps the row to the right Android page or checks the Silent, held back and blocked rows' words. The states are checked only as data.
expected: A phone test that turns off one permission, sees the matching row, taps it and lands on the right Android page.
fix_line: Make the phone test assert the row and its tap instead of only taking a picture

title: The exercise rest picker is never checked on screen
what: Phone tests only tap a rest chip by name and see the sheet close. No test reads the sheet's title, which chip is selected, the Custom minute and second boxes, the 'Pick a rest from 0:05 to 10:00.' line, or the line shown when the phone cannot keep the choice. An imported 7:00 rest showing as the selected Custom chip is never tried.
expected: A test opens the rest picker from an exercise, sees the selected chip, types a custom length, tries a length out of range and a failed save, and sees the right words each time.
fix_line: Add one phone flow for the exercise rest picker: selected chip, Custom, out of range, failed save.

title: The rest bar's plus 15 and minus 15 buttons and 'Turn on' are never pressed in a test
what: Phone tests see the rest bar and press Skip, but never press +15 or -15 and read the clock, never take a rest down to zero, never press the 'Turn on' line when alerts are off, and never check there is no bar before the first tick.
expected: A test presses +15 and -15 and sees the clock move by 15 seconds, takes a short rest to zero and sees the bar go quietly, and presses Turn on to reach the phone's settings.
fix_line: Extend the rest bar phone flow to press +15, -15 and Turn on and read the results.

title: The 'Keep it?' question is never required on screen and Fix is never tested
what: The phone flow that types 300 kg taps Keep only if it happens to show, so the test passes even when the question never appears. No test presses Fix to untick the set, end its rest and put the cursor back in the weight box, or checks the question is not asked again for a normal weight. The 'Add reps first' row line and its gentle shake are checked only as words, never on screen.
expected: A test types a far-too-heavy weight, must see the question, presses Fix and sees the set unticked with no rest running; another ticks an empty row and sees the 'Add reps first' line.
fix_line: Make the Keep step required in the 300 kg flow and add a Fix step after it.

title: Warm-up and Failure set types are never chosen in a test
what: Phone tests only pick 'Drop set' and 'Remove set' from the set type sheet. No test picks Warm-up or Failure and sees the row read W or F, turns a warm-up back into a normal set, or closes the sheet without choosing and sees nothing change.
expected: A test picks each set type, sees the row mark change and the working-set count follow, and backs out once to see the set unchanged.
fix_line: Add Warm-up, Failure, back to Normal and a back-out to the existing drop set flow.

title: The workout recap's odd cases are never tested
what: No test checks the recap of a past workout in History (its tiles and open Exercises fold), the 'Log your body weight so pull-ups and dips count' line, a workout with no working sets, or the recap after a set was removed from a saved workout.
expected: Tests show the recap for a past workout, a pull-up workout with no body weight, an empty workout and an edited workout, and check the tiles, folds and line each time.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the recap's past, empty, no-body-weight and edited cases.

title: When sharing fails or is cancelled, no test checks what the member sees
what: Sharing a workout picture, a workout as text and a routine each has its own message for a phone with no share app, a failure, or a picture that takes too long, and each must work again after the member cancels. No test reaches any of these messages or tries sharing twice after a cancel.
expected: Tests make each share fail and see its message, and cancel the share list then share again with success.
fix_line: Add small tests that make the share step fail or cancel for picture, text and routine.

title: Parts of bringing routines in are never tested on screen
what: No test brings routines in from a Strong import, opens a single Hevy routine link and its 'to which folder?' screen, sees the disabled 'Tick a routine' button, closes the steps with nothing saved, or goes back from check screen 2 to 1 and sees the ticks kept.
expected: Phone or screen tests cover a Strong import, a single routine link, the nothing-ticked button and Back between check screens.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the routine steps for Strong, a single link, nothing ticked and Back.

title: The sleep and protein line on the finish screen is never shown in a test
what: The rules behind the line are well tested as data, but no test shows the finish screen with the sleep line or a protein tip, and none checks that the screen drawing again keeps the same line instead of counting a second tip as shown.
expected: A test shows the finish screen after a lighter workout with a short night and with a tip due, and draws it twice to see one tip counted.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the finish line: sleep, tip, and a second draw.

title: Timed, distance and target rows of a workout are barely tested
what: A phone test starts a plank's hold timer, but no test checks a typed time reads 1:30, a treadmill row shows no weight box and no '0 kg', or the target's 'i' stops pulsing and stays still with Reduce motion on.
expected: Tests tick a timed and a distance row and read them back, and check the target 'i' pulse stops and is off with Reduce motion.
fix_line: Add asserts to the existing all-kinds phone flow for the time, distance and target rows.

title: The strength level sheet is never tested on screen
what: Only the level maths and the line's words are tested. No test opens 'What this means', checks the member's level is marked, taps Women and sees the level change, or checks the choice is still there when the sheet opens again. The privacy sentence is not checked either.
expected: A phone test opens the sheet, changes the comparison, sees the level move, reopens and finds the choice kept, and reads the privacy line.
fix_line: Add a phone test of the strength level sheet and its comparison chips

title: Making and joining a superset is only half tested
what: The phone test makes one superset and stops at 'Edit superset'. No test checks both cards carry the badge, that typed sets survive, that joining moves the card next to its group, or the message shown when the workout has only one exercise.
expected: Tests check both cards are marked, typed sets are kept, a joined card moves beside its group, and the one-exercise sheet says how to make a superset.
fix_line: Extend the superset phone test and add the one-exercise sheet case

title: Swapping an exercise in a routine, and a failed swap, are never tested
what: No test swaps an exercise on a routine's page and checks the sets and reps stay; the only test touching that step replaces it with a stand-in. No test shows the no-close-match sheet or the 'Could not swap' message, and none checks sore areas are left out of the choices.
expected: A database test swaps an exercise in a routine and finds the same sets and reps; small tests cover the no-match words, the failed swap keeping the old card, and sore areas.
fix_line: Add a real-database routine swap test and the failure cases

title: The Hevy or Strong pick on the welcome screen is never tested
what: Only the card's sentence and when the card may show are tested. No test picks Hevy on the welcome screen and checks the import opens once after setup, never again, and not after a backup restore. No test taps 'From Strong' and checks the Strong import opens.
expected: A phone test picks an app on the welcome screen and sees its import open once; small tests cover the pick being dropped on a restore and taken back.
fix_line: Add a welcome-pick phone test and the restore case

title: The 'Demo data · Remove' strip is never tested
what: The removal itself is well tested on a real database, but only from Settings. No test checks the strip shows on every tab while the demo is loaded, shows 'Removing...', goes away when the data stops being the demo, or shows 'Could not remove the demo' after a failure.
expected: A phone test loads the demo, sees the strip on each tab, removes it from the strip, and a small test covers the failure message and a single question.
fix_line: Add a phone test that removes the demo from the strip

title: The Gym tab badge and the tab bar over the keyboard are never tested
what: The unread count is tested as data only. No test checks the number on the Gym icon, the '9+' cap, the screen reader words, the new-feature dot, or that the tab bar steps aside when the keyboard opens.
expected: Tests check the badge shows the count and '9+', the dot never shows with a number, and the tab bar hides while typing.
fix_line: Add a badge test and a typing check to a phone flow

title: Old trainer videos after a link is removed or the member changes gym are never tested
what: The link rules are tested, but no test checks a link the trainer removed disappears, or that after leaving gym A its trainer's name and videos are gone for gym B. The 'Couldn't open the video' message is not tested.
expected: Tests check the card goes when the link is removed, no card of gym A shows after joining gym B, and the open-failed message shows.
fix_line: Add tests for a removed link, a gym change and a failed open

title: The workout bar above the tabs is barely tested
what: Only where the bar shows is tested. No test checks its words, the rest countdown matching the workout screen, the 'Editing a workout' state with no clock, the 'Workout paused' state on the bar, or the bar going after the finish.
expected: Tests check the bar's words in each state and that its rest time matches the workout screen.
fix_line: Add tests for each state of the workout bar

title: Photos on the finish screen and in the cloud copy are never tested
what: No test adds a photo on the 'Workout complete' summary or in Edit workout, and no test checks the cloud copy leaves workout photos out. The promise 'Private. They stay on this phone.' rests on code nobody tests.
expected: A test adds a photo from the summary and finds it on the saved workout, and a cloud copy test checks no workout photo is sent.
fix_line: Add a summary-photo test and a cloud-copy check for photos

title: A deleted or unreadable saved workout page is never tested
what: No test opens a workout that was deleted and checks 'Workout not found', opens one whose read fails and checks Try again, or renames one and checks the failure message or the new title. Removing the workout on its page is not tested either.
expected: Tests cover not found, a failed read, a rename and removing the workout on its saved page.
fix_line: Add tests for the saved workout page's error and edit paths

title: The workout calendar and list updates are never tested
what: No test opens the calendar's day list or checks 'No workout that day.' No test checks a renamed or deleted workout updates its card and the range count, or that a chart's workout list holds only that range.
expected: Tests check the calendar day list, the empty day words, and the list after a rename and a delete.
fix_line: Add tests for the calendar and for list updates after edits

title: The AI coach notes switch is never tested, so workouts could reach the AI with it off
what: No test checks the 'AI coach notes' switch: that it shows with the coach, that the built-in note shows with it off, or that no call goes to the AI coach for a workout when it is off.
expected: A test finishes a workout with the switch off and checks no AI call is made and the built-in note shows.
fix_line: Add a test that the AI coach is not called with the switch off

title: The body-weight moves switch on the Last time's numbers page is never tested on screen
what: The rule behind the switch is tested, but no test checks the switch shows only with Same routine, keeps its value after leaving the page, or comes back still on.
expected: A test switches between the two choices and checks the switch hides, shows and keeps its value.
fix_line: Add a settings test for the body-weight switch

title: Easy weeks in Settings is never tested
what: No test checks the Easy weeks card shows only for a followed plan, matches the folder menu, shows the hint with no plan, keeps its value after a failed save, or brings the next easy week back when turned on again.
expected: Tests cover the Easy weeks card with and without a followed plan, a failed save, and off then on.
fix_line: Add tests for the Easy weeks setting

title: The weekly goal page's screen reader words and the widget count are never tested
what: No test checks the screen reader reads '1 workout a week' (not '1 workouts'), that it can change the goal, or that the home-screen widget shows the same count as Up next after a change.
expected: A test reads the page's spoken words and checks the widget count follows the goal.
fix_line: Add spoken-words and widget checks for the weekly goal

title: No test makes a Workout tab save fail
what: On the Workout tab, no test makes a save fail and checks what the member sees. That covers a new folder or routine order, the easy-weeks setting, a folder delete, and the routine list that cannot load (three quiet retries, then 'Couldn't load your routines' with a retry). Every test of these parts only checks saves that work.
expected: At least one test per action makes the save fail and checks the plain message, that the old value stays on screen, and that the list never sticks on a skeleton or shows 'No routines yet' when routines exist.
how_often: whenever the phone refuses a write
fix_line: Add tests that make each Workout tab save fail and check the message and the old value

title: No test checks the widget and reminder while a workout is open
what: No test checks that the home-screen widget says 'Resume' while a workout is open, or that no workout reminder fires that day. No test checks that both go back to normal, and the lock-screen card goes away, once the workout ends. The reminder tests only check days already trained.
expected: A test opens a workout and checks the widget's 'Resume' and that no reminder fires. It then ends the workout and checks the widget, the reminder and the lock-screen card are back to normal, and that correcting a saved workout does not count as open.
fix_line: Add a test for the widget and reminder while a workout is open and after it ends

title: No test covers what goes wrong on the New exercise screen
what: No test checks any problem on the New exercise screen: a name already in the library, a save that fails, a refused camera, a video that is too long or too large. No test checks that changing a photo deletes the old file, or that cancelling a change keeps the old picture. The tests only check forms that save cleanly and the sheets opening.
expected: Tests for each problem check its pop-up words and that Save can be tapped again. A test also checks that replacing a photo leaves one file on the phone.
how_often: each time a member makes or changes their own exercise
fix_line: Add tests for the duplicate name, save error, camera, video limits and photo replacement

title: No test covers Repeat, Edit or a failure on the Profile feed
what: From a Profile feed card's menu, no test checks Repeat (a new workout with the same exercises, and never replacing an open one without asking) or Edit ('Can't edit this one' with the reason). No test checks the words for a workout deleted on another screen, a failed action, or a failed delete.
expected: Tests start Repeat and Edit from a feed card, including with a workout open. They also check 'Couldn’t open this workout. It may have been deleted.', 'That didn’t work' and 'Could not delete this workout. It is still here.'
how_often: each time a member repeats or edits a past workout from Profile
fix_line: Add phone tests for Repeat, Edit and the failure words on the Profile feed

title: No screen test of merging or hiding exercises
what: Merging and hiding exercises are tested only in the database. expected: Server tests for the repeat, the already-on-the-list refusal, the bad-number refusal, and the old key retired with the session still live.

title: The Pro-only lock on body measurements and diet plans is never tested
what: The server blocks new body measurements and diet plans for a gym not on Pro, but the plan test checks the lock only for the shop, branding, workout plans and challenges. A change that drops the lock on these two would pass.
expected: The plan test also tries a measurement and a diet plan on a Starter gym and sees the Pro-only refusal.
who: gyms on Starter, and MettleUp's income
how_often: once the plan switch is on
fix_line: Add a measurement and a diet plan to the Pro-only part of the plan test

title: The timings test never checks late-night hours of yesterday or that members cannot see who changed the hours
what: The timings test drops a special day that is 5 days old, but never one from yesterday whose hours run past midnight. It also never checks that the member's read leaves out who last changed the hours; today the code leaves it out, but nothing keeps it so.
expected: The test saves yesterday's late special day and checks it still shows tonight, and checks the member read has no name of who changed the hours.
fix_line: Add a yesterday-past-midnight special day and a no-name check on the member read to the timings test

title: No test shows the desk which members are hidden from the leaderboard
what: The leaderboard test checks the owner's board marks hidden members, and that the desk cannot hide anyone. It never checks that the desk's board marks a hidden member.
expected: The test reads the desk's board after the owner hides a member and sees the hidden mark.
fix_line: Check the hidden mark on the desk's board in the leaderboard test

title: Pop-up jobs are never tested for a failed job, a second job for one offer, or being cleared away
what: The pop-up test checks one job for a message and an offer job. It never shows that a message still sends when making its pop-up job fails, that saving the same offer twice makes only one job, or that finished jobs are deleted.
expected: Tests cover a failed job not blocking the send, one job per offer, and finished jobs deleted.
fix_line: Add the three cases to the pop-up test

title: No test checks a diet plan comes back when a membership is renewed
what: The diet test checks a member whose membership ended sees no plan sent by membership plan. It never renews that member and checks the plan comes back.
expected: The test renews the ended member and sees the plan again.
fix_line: Renew the ended member in the diet test and check the plan returns

title: A stranger who types a mobile at check-in learns whether it belongs to a gym member
what: A number on the gym's list gets the "go to the desk" answer, while a number on no list gets "the gym doesn't have your number". The test pins both answers, so anyone with the app can learn which numbers are the gym's members, a few tries a day per new install.
expected: A typed number gets the same answer whether or not it is on the list, and a test checks the two answers match.
fix_line: Give one desk answer for every typed number and test that it is the same

title: No test checks a sent report is kept 30 days from sending
what: The report test checks only that a request expires 30 days after it was asked. The server restarts the 30 days when the file is sent, but nothing tests that, so a change could delete a report early or keep it too long.
expected: A test sends a file late in the 30 days and checks the new end is 30 days after sending.
fix_line: Add one check on the end date right after a file is sent

title: Declining a check-in number or a plan request is barely tested
what: For a no, the tests check only that nothing was linked or changed. Who declined and when, the 14 days a declined number stays listed, and pressing No twice are never checked, for check-in numbers or for pause and renew requests.
expected: Tests read back who declined and when, press No twice and get the same answer, and check a declined number leaves the list after 14 days.
fix_line: Add the who, when, repeat and 14-day checks to the two tests

title: Taken-back messages and a staff try at sending are not checked against the daily limit
what: The limit test never takes a message back before counting to 10, never checks a refused staff send leaves the day's count alone, and never checks a taken-back message leaves the member's list or that a read message is marked read.
expected: Tests take one back and still hit the limit at 10, try a staff send and count again, and read the member list after a take-back.
fix_line: Add three checks to the message limit test

title: A pass member's check-in is tested with one scan only
what: Pass members are checked in once in the tests. A second scan the same day, another gym's poster, the rate limits and the gym name and first name in the answer are tested only for paying members.
expected: The pass member test scans twice, scans another gym's poster and reads the names in the answer.
fix_line: Add the repeat and other-gym scans to the pass member test

title: Trainer rules for a removed person, another trainer's member and moving a member are untested
what: No test ticks a removed person as trainer, checks a help mark is not shown to the wrong trainer, or moves a member from one trainer to another and checks only the new trainer sees them.
expected: Tests try each of the three and check the refusal or that only one trainer sees the member.
fix_line: Add three cases to the trainer test

title: After a restore, members who deleted their account in the last day come back, and nothing says to delete them again
what: The nightly copy keeps a member who deleted their account until it expires. The restore drill only checks that every row comes back identical. Neither the drill nor the written restore steps say to delete again the accounts that were deleted after the copy was taken, so a real restore quietly brings those members and their data back.
expected: The restore steps list the accounts deleted since the copy and delete them again, and a test or drill step checks that a member deleted after the copy is gone after the restore.
fix_line: Add a re-delete step to the restore guide and to the drill, using HQ's own record of deleted accounts

title: No test proves a failed member pop-up never undoes the gym's own approval, order change or report request
what: The pop-up notes are made inside the gym's own save (a pause approval, an order marked ready, a report request). The code turns any failure there into a warning, but no test makes the note fail and checks the gym's action still saved. No test checks that finished notes are later cleaned away either.
expected: A database test that forces the note step to fail and sees the approval, order and report request still saved, and one that sees old finished notes removed on a later run.
fix_line: Add two checks to the member pop-up database test: a failing note and the clean-up of old ones

title: Replying to a member's question in a paused gym, the 200-question list cap and the 180-day removal are never tested
what: The question test checks who sees a question, replies, taking back and leaving. It never tries a reply from a gym that is suspended, never fills the list past 200 or 60 days, and never ages a question past 180 days to see it removed.
expected: Database checks that a suspended gym's reply is refused SUSPENDED and not saved, that the list stops at 200 recent questions, and that a question older than 180 days is gone.
fix_line: Add the three missing checks to the ask-a-trainer database test

title: The trainer-question journeys promise short surnames and owner-cannot-read, but the phone test for the newer page shows full names and says the owner reads it too
what: The server journeys and the older database test say a member sees 'Rohit S.' and that a question sent to one trainer is hidden from the owner. The phone test for the newer 'Message your gym' page taps 'Vikram Rao' and 'Tara Singh (your trainer)' and checks the line 'The owner of the gym can read it too.' So the tests guard two different privacy promises and nobody checks which one members are told.
expected: One agreed rule for names and for whether the owner reads a trainer's question, written into the journeys and checked by both the database and the phone tests.
fix_line: Update the old journeys and test to the newer rule, or retire the old ask path

title: A member who left, or changed their check-in number, is never tested against the gym's payment requests
what: The payment-identity test checks matching, shared numbers, another gym and a dead key. It never makes a member leave and checks the gym's payment requests stop, and never changes a member's check-in number to see the requests stop until it matches again.
expected: Database checks that a member who left is refused and gets no request, and that a changed number gives no place on the list until it matches.
fix_line: Add a left member and a changed number to the payment-identity database test

title: No test checks that a personal-training booking hides the member's phone, fees and body numbers
what: The trainer week test reads bookings as the desk and as trainers, but never checks what each booking carries. A later change could add the member's phone or money to every booking and all tests would still pass.
expected: A test reads a booking as a trainer and as the desk and checks it holds only the name, time and trainer.
fix_line: Add a check that a booking carries no phone, fee or body numbers

title: The nightly test-gym clean-up is tested on one gym row only
what: The clean-up test deletes one test gym and checks the gym row and the log code. It never checks the 100-a-night limit, that the gym's members, check-ins and terms rows go too, or that the log carries no member names or phones.
expected: Tests prove the limit, that every row of a deleted test gym goes, and that the log names only gyms.
fix_line: Give the test gym members and terms rows, and many test gyms, and check all of it

title: The desk journey expects a question sent to the front desk, but the server refuses that
what: One front desk journey starts with a member question sent to "Gym admin". The database test proves such a question is refused; only feedback and complaints may go to "Gym admin". The journey describes something that can never happen, so its first step can never be tested.
expected: The journey and the server agree on who a question can go to.
fix_line: Change the journey to start with a feedback sent to the front desk

title: The refusal and done lines of Message your gym are never checked on a screen
what: The database test proves empty, too many, paused-gym, nameless-complaint and full-conversation messages are refused. No test shows the member or the owner the words for any of these, or the member's "marked this as done" and "Sent." lines.
expected: Each refusal and status line is checked once on the phone or in the admin app.
fix_line: Add phone and admin app checks for each refusal line

title: The paid-features lock switch is not tested on screen, offline, for the desk or for a member who left
what: Tests cover the switch's saved value and the app's lock rule. Nothing opens the Settings card as owner or desk, saves it with no internet, shows the desk the new value after the owner changes it, or checks a member who left and a locked member's own data.
expected: The card is checked for owner and desk, offline, and a locked member still sees all their own data.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the card for owner and desk, offline, and a locked member

title: No test sends a gym note to a phone whose first name does not match, or with another gym's id
what: The pop-up test covers a shared number, but never a list entry whose first name differs from the app member, and never hands the fee list an item with a wrong gym id. A note could reach the wrong person and the tests would pass.
expected: Tests prove no note is made for a name that does not match or a wrong gym id.
fix_line: Add a mismatched first name and a wrong gym id to the test

title: No test closes a member question after 14 days with no reply
what: The question tests answer, take back and refuse questions, but none ages a question past 14 days. Nothing proves it leaves "Waiting for your reply" or that "Closed with no reply after 14 days." appears.
expected: A test ages a question 14 days and checks it closes and shows the closed line.
fix_line: Add a test that ages a question and checks it closes

title: Find my gym's not-found, too-many and pass lines are never checked
what: The server test proves the search answers, but no test checks the member sees "We did not find your gym", the too-many-searches line, or "You train there on a pass."
expected: Each of these lines is checked once in the phone app.
fix_line: Add word checks for the not-found, too-many and pass lines

title: The bell list's 3-day limit and its 50-alert cap are never tested
what: No database test puts a 4-day-old alert or more than 50 alerts in a gym and checks what the bell list returns. The only date check asks for alerts newer than now, so the 3-day window and the cap could break unseen.
expected: A test with alerts from 4 days ago and today, and 51 recent ones, checks only the last 3 days come back, newest first, at most 50.
fix_line: Add old and over-50 alerts to the alerts database test and check the list

title: The 30-day clean-up of old alerts is never tested
what: Old alerts are deleted at random, about once in 100 writes. No test checks that alerts older than 30 days go, or that the new alert written at that moment is kept.
expected: A test forces the clean-up and checks old alerts are gone and the new one is saved.
fix_line: Add a clean-up check that does not depend on chance

title: No test proves a member's action still saves when its alert fails
what: The tests only call the alert writer alone with a bad line. They never make the alert fail inside a real shop order, complaint, check-in number, question or join and check the member's action is still saved.
expected: For at least one real member action, a test makes the alert write fail and checks the order or message is still kept.
fix_line: Add a test where the alert fails during a real member action

title: The page a real alert opens is never checked for shop, check-in, plan and trainer-question alerts
what: For a real shop order, check-in number, plan request and a question sent to one trainer, the tests check the line or the urgent flag but not the page the alert opens. The check-in alert's words from a real member are never checked at all; tests only type that line by hand.
expected: Each real member action is tested for its exact line and its page (Shop, Today, Member messages).
fix_line: Check the line and page of each real alert in the alerts test

title: The online-payment alert call's count and its 100-item limit are never tested
what: The database test never reads the answer of the payment alert call, and never hands it more than 100 items. The Worker test only uses a pretend answer.
expected: A test checks the answer counts the alerts written and that only 100 items are handled in one call.
fix_line: Read the call's answer and send 101 items in the alerts test

title: Removing or giving back the trainer tick is never tested on the bell
what: Tests check that a person without the trainer tick never sees question alerts, but never remove the tick from a trainer who already has a question in the bell, and never give it back.
expected: A test removes a trainer's tick and checks the question alert leaves the bell while other alerts stay, then gives it back and checks the alert returns.
how_often: whenever an owner changes a trainer
fix_line: Add the untick and re-tick steps to the alerts test

title: No test checks a plan request that is no longer waiting makes no alert
what: The plan request tests only write new waiting requests. No test checks that a request already approved or refused gets no alert.
expected: A test writes a request that is not waiting and checks no alert is made.
fix_line: Add a not-waiting request to the alerts test

title: A job name that is too long is cut short without a word, and the test locks that in
what: When the owner types a staff job longer than 40 letters, the admin app quietly cuts it to 40 and saves that. The test of the job box checks that a long job is cut, which is the opposite of the journey. The gym server would refuse it with a message, but the app never sends it the long text.
expected: The owner is told the job is too long and nothing is saved, or the box shows how many letters are left so nothing is cut by surprise.
how_often: rare: only a job over 40 letters
fix_line: Show a letters-left count or a too-long message instead of cutting silently, and change the test to match

title: Nothing tests that a friend invite at a paused gym rings nobody
